def: Biror narsa zararli, xavfli yoki noqulay bo'lishi mumkin.
ex: I worry that the tornado will have an adverse effect on the farm.
exuz: Tornado fermaga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatishidan xavotirdaman.

def: Muqobil variant boshqa tanlovdir.
ex: Taking the bus and driving to work are alternate ways to travel.
exuz: Avtobusda borish va ishga mashinada borish — sayohatning muqobil yo'llari.

def: Material tabiatga zarar qilmaydigan moddalarga o'z-o'zidan parchalanadi.
ex: I use biodegradable compost to feed my garden.
exuz: Men bog'imni oziqlantirish uchun tabiiy parchalanadigan kompost ishlataman.

def: Biror narsa o'ramning ichida bo'lsa.
ex: Justine brought a boxed gift to the birthday party.
exuz: Jastin tug'ilgan kun ziyofatiga qutiga solingan sovg'a olib keldi.

def: Biror narsa tufayli nafas ololmay qolish.
ex: The gum Malinda swallowed made her choke.
exuz: Malinda yutib yuborgan saqich uni bo'g'ib qo'ydi.

def: Biror narsa vaqt yoki kuchingizni tejaydi.
ex: Walking through the park is a convenient way to exercise on the way to work.
exuz: Park orqali yurish ishga ketayotib mashq qilishning qulay yo'li.

def: Biror narsani tashlab yuborish.
ex: After repairing the window, discard any broken glass.
exuz: Derazani ta'mirlagandan keyin sinik shishalarni tashlab yuboring.

def: Havodan nafas oladigan katta dengiz sutemizuvchisi.
ex: Intelligent dolphins have learned to communicate with humans.
exuz: Aqlli delfinlar odamlar bilan muloqot qilishni o'rganishgan.

def: Biror ish tirik mavjudotlar va atrof-muhitni hisobga olib qilinadi.
ex: We planted our garden according to ecologically correct practices.
exuz: Biz bog'imizni ekologik jihatdan to'g'ri usullarda ekdik.

def: Biror narsa o'limga sabab bo'ladi.
ex: Being shot by the attacker proved fatal to the victim.
exuz: Hujumchining o'qi qurbon uchun o'limga olib keldi.

def: Biror narsa necha marta sodir bo'lishi.
ex: We need to increase the incidence of success in school.
exuz: Biz maktabda muvaffaqiyat darajasini oshirishimiz kerak.

def: Biror narsa shahar yoki mahalliy hukumatga tegishli.
ex: The municipal parking lot downtown can fit one hundred cars.
exuz: Shahar markazidagi shahar to'xtash joyiga yuzta mashina sig'adi.

def: Biror narsa juda ko'p ishlatilganda sodir bo'ladi.
ex: Rochelle's overuse of the exercise bike caused the gears to break.
exuz: Rochelning mashq velosipedini haddan ziyod ishlatishi uzatmalarning sinishiga olib keldi.

def: Ko'ldan kichikroq chuchuk suv havzasi.
ex: I learned to swim at the pond behind the recreation center.
exuz: Men dam olish markazi orqasidagi hovuzda suzishni o'rgandim.

def: Narsani ishlatib bo'lgach, qismlaridan boshqa narsa yasash.
ex: We recycle our newspapers so that they can be made into packing boxes.
exuz: Biz gazetalarni qayta ishlaymiz, ular o'ram qutilariga aylantirilishi uchun.

def: Narsadan qayta-qayta foydalanish mumkin.
ex: Saburo keeps his empty jelly jars because they are reusable for storing sewing supplies.
exuz: Saburo bo'sh jem bankalarini saqlaydi, chunki ular tikuv buyumlarini saqlash uchun qayta ishlatiladi.

def: Biror narsa kichik joyga tiqilgan.
ex: The newspapers were all stuffed into the drawer.
exuz: Gazetalarning hammasi tortmaga tiqib qo'yilgan edi.

def: Voqea o'lim yoki azob keltirishi mumkinligi uchun qayg'u keltiradi.
ex: The entire community attended the memorial service for the victims of the tragic fire.
exuz: Butun jamoa fojiali yong'in qurbonlari xotirasiga bag'ishlangan marosimda qatnashdi.

def: Biror narsadan ma'lum maqsad uchun foydalanish.
ex: The team can utilize the lab equipment to complete the experiment.
exuz: Jamoa tajribani tugatish uchun laboratoriya jihozlaridan foydalana oladi.

def: Okeanda yashaydigan juda katta sutemizuvchi.
ex: We were surprised when a whale surfaced next to our boat.
exuz: Qayig'imiz yonida kit suv yuziga chiqqanda biz hayron bo'ldik.

def: Hobbi uchun biror ish qiladigan va buning uchun pul olmaydigan odam.
ex: The amateur took pictures just as well as the person who worked for money.
exuz: Havaskor pul evaziga ishlaydigan odamdek yaxshi suratga oldi.

def: Biror narsa butunlay aniq emas.
ex: It's ambiguous as to whether a newborn baby looks like a girl or a boy.
exuz: Yangi tug'ilgan chaqaloq qiz yoki o'g'il bolaga o'xshashi noaniq.

def: Kimdir kimligini hech kim bilmaydi.
ex: An anonymous donor gave a thousand dollars to the museum.
exuz: Anonim donor muzeyga ming dollar berdi.

def: Biror narsada muvaffaqiyat qozonish yoki xohlagan narsangizga ega bo'lish.
ex: If you want to attain a healthy body, you must exercise every day.
exuz: Sog'lom tanaga erishmoqchi bo'lsangiz, har kuni mashq qilishingiz kerak.

def: Erkinlik yoki mustaqillikning boshqa nomi.
ex: In the 1800s, the people of India fought for autonomy from Britain.
exuz: 1800-yillarda Hindiston xalqi Britaniyadan mustaqillik uchun kurashdi.

def: Bir kishi boshqasi uchun voz kechadigan narsa.
ex: China gave Hong Kong to Britain as a concession after the war.
exuz: Xitoy urushdan keyin Gonkongni Britaniyaga yon berish sifatida berdi.

def: Biror narsa asta-sekin tabiiy tarzda buzilishi natijasi.
ex: The decay in the old building was obvious.
exuz: Eski binodagi yemirilish aniq ko'rinib turardi.

def: Biror joyda yashash.
ex: Before he was a successful writer, Mark Twain dwelled in the city of Hannibal, Missouri.
exuz: Muvaffaqiyatli yozuvchi bo'lishidan oldin Mark Tven Missuri shtatining Xannibal shahrida yashagan.

def: Kimgadir biror narsa haqida o'rgatish.
ex: Greek philosophers wanted to enlighten the people of Athens with their ideas.
exuz: Yunon faylasuflari g'oyalari bilan Afina aholisiga ma'rifat bermoqchi edi.

def: Kimnidir boy qilish yoki boyligini oshirish.
ex: Taxes on people's income can be used to enrich the government.
exuz: Odamlar daromadidan olinadigan soliqlar hukumatni boyitish uchun ishlatilishi mumkin.

def: Juda yaxshi ishlash va ajoyib holatda bo'lish.
ex: The Roman Empire flourished in Europe two thousand years ago.
exuz: Rim imperiyasi ikki ming yil oldin Yevropada gullab-yashnagan.

def: Shakllar va ularni o'lchashni o'rganadigan fan.
ex: If you want to be able to calculate the area of a circle, you must study geometry.
exuz: Doira yuzini hisoblay olishni xohlasangiz, geometriyani o'rganishingiz kerak.

def: Chaqnash va yarqirash.
ex: The waves of the ocean would gleam every night at sunset.
exuz: Okean to'lqinlari har oqshom quyosh botganda yaltirab turardi.

def: Kerak yoki kerak bo'lganidan ko'proq narsa xohlash.
ex: The story of King Midas is a story of greed.
exuz: Shoh Midas haqidagi hikoya — ochko'zlik hikoyasi.

def: Hamma narsa tinch, muvozanatli va kelishilgan degan his.
ex: The United Nations is struggling to bring peace and harmony to the world.
exuz: Birlashgan Millatlar Tashkiloti dunyoga tinchlik va uyg'unlik keltirish uchun kurashmoqda.

def: Biror narsa yoki kimdir muhit yoki hududda tabiiy ravishda mavjud.
ex: The Pueblo people were an indigenous tribe in Arizona who lived in adobe homes.
exuz: Pueblo xalqi Arizonaning tub aholisi bo'lib, loy uylarda yashagan.

def: Qonun bo'yicha hukm chiqarish va uni amalga oshirish huquqi.
ex: We did not have jurisdiction to bring the criminal to trial.
exuz: Bizning jinoyatchini sudga berish vakolatimiz yo'q edi.

def: Birin-ketin keladigan yoki ko'rsatiladigan odamlar yoki narsalar qatori.
ex: This parade of elephants is part of an open-air exhibit to honor these majestic animals.
exuz: Fillar paradi — bu ulug'vor hayvonlarni ulug'lash uchun ochiq havodagi ko'rgazmaning bir qismi.

def: Odatda tosh, loy yoki metalldan yasalgan uch o'lchamli san'at asari.
ex: The Venus de Milo is a famous ancient Greek statue.
exuz: Milos Venerasi — mashhur qadimgi Yunon haykali.

def: Hech qachon jinsiy aloqada bo'lmagan odam.
ex: The virgin goddess of the moon was known as Diana.
exuz: Oyning bokira ma'budasi Diana nomi bilan mashhur edi.

def: Biror narsa oddiy yoki o'rtachadan farq qiladi.
ex: I felt abnormal this morning, like I was sick.
exuz: Bugun ertalab o'zimni g'ayritabiiy his qildim, go'yo kasaldekman.

def: Kimdir yoki nimadir kutilgan joyda emas.
ex: I was absent from school yesterday because I went on a trip with my father.
exuz: Men kecha dadam bilan safarga ketganim uchun maktabda yo'q edim.

def: Biror narsa boshqasining yonida yoki tutashgan.
ex: My apartment is adjacent to a lovely park and playground.
exuz: Mening kvartiram chiroyli park va o'yin maydonchasi yonida.

def: Yengil kumushrang kimyoviy element.
ex: I used the aluminum foil to wrap the food.
exuz: Men ovqatni o'rash uchun alyuminiy folga ishlatdim.

def: Biror narsa odam yoki narsaga taalluqli.
ex: I discovered that my old password was no longer applicable to the website.
exuz: Men eski parolim endi veb-saytga mos kelmasligini aniqladim.

def: Biror narsa tabiiy emas, tabiiyga o'xshatib yasalgan.
ex: The artificial Christmas tree was made of plastic.
exuz: Sun'iy Rojdestvo daraxti plastmassadan yasalgan edi.

def: Pedal bilan haydaladigan ikki g'ildirakli transport.
ex: I rode my bicycle down the mountain road.
exuz: Men velosipedimda tog' yo'li bo'ylab tushdim.

def: Boshqalar uchun biror narsaning tafsilotlarini kelishish yoki tartibga solish.
ex: The lawyer will broker our agreement.
exuz: Advokat bizning kelishuvimizda vositachilik qiladi.

def: Katta biznes yoki mamlakatni boshqarishga yordam beradigan odamlar guruhi.
ex: The members of the bureaucracy were flooded with too many petitions.
exuz: Byurokratiya a'zolari juda ko'p arizalarga ko'milib ketdi.

def: Biror narsani tayyor qilib joylashtirish.
ex: The engineer helped to configure my new computer.
exuz: Muhandis yangi kompyuterimni sozlashga yordam berdi.

def: Biror narsani bitta qilib qo'shish yoki birga olib kelish.
ex: When we moved in together, we had to consolidate our belongings.
exuz: Birga ko'chib o'tganimizda biz buyumlarimizni birlashtirishimizga to'g'ri keldi.

def: Biror narsa sizga osongina qilishga imkon beradi.
ex: I love the convenience of having a swimming pool in my back yard.
exuz: Men orqa hovlimda basseyn borligining qulayligini yaxshi ko'raman.

def: Biror narsani ayirish.
ex: I had to deduct my expenses from my checkbook.
exuz: Men xarajatlarimni chek daftarimdan ayirishim kerak edi.

def: Biror narsani o'ylab ko'rib baholash.
ex: I deemed the ice cream to be very delicious.
exuz: Men muzqaymoqni juda mazali deb hisobladim.

def: Pul topish uchun yangi biznes yoki tashkilot boshlaydigan odam.
ex: The entrepreneur made a success out of his new business.
exuz: Tadbirkor yangi biznesidan muvaffaqiyat yaratdi.

def: Biror narsa teng miqdorlarga bo'lingan.
ex: Sprinkle the sugar evenly all over the cookies.
exuz: Shakarni pechenyelarning ustiga teng sepib chiqing.

def: Pul yoki moliya, ayniqsa hukumat yoki biznes moliyasiga oid.
ex: Did the company show fiscal growth this year?
exuz: Kompaniya bu yil moliyaviy o'sish ko'rsatdimi?

def: Boshqa kompaniya mahsulot yoki xizmatlarini ma'lum hududda sotish huquqi.
ex: The fast food restaurant has a franchise near my home.
exuz: Tez ovqatlanish restoranining uyim yaqinida franshizasi bor.

def: Biror narsa e'tiqod yoki g'oyalar tizimiga, ayniqsa hukumat yoki iqtisodiyotga oid.
ex: The citizens of England had ideological differences about their government.
exuz: Angliya fuqarolari hukumati haqida mafkuraviy qarama-qarshiliklarga ega edi.

def: Odam ishini bajara oladigan mashina.
ex: I bought a robot that can clean the floor on its own.
exuz: Men polni o'zi tozalay oladigan robot sotib oldim.

def: Rohiblar yoki rohibalar yashaydigan uy yoki uylar guruhi.
ex: When the monk returned to the abbey, he went immediately to his bedroom.
exuz: Rohib monastirga qaytgach, darhol yotoqxonasiga ketdi.

def: Biror narsa katta miqdorda mavjud.
ex: Cakes, cookies, and candy were so abundant that the child was very happy.
exuz: Tort, pechenye va konfet shunchalik mo'l ediki, bola juda xursand edi.

def: Biror narsaning yonida yoki unga ulangan bo'lish.
ex: She can listen to her brother's conversations because her room adjoins his.
exuz: U akasining gaplarini eshita oladi, chunki uning xonasi akasinikiga tutashgan.

def: Biror narsa yetarli yoki ortiqcha.
ex: There was an ample supply of oats to feed the horses.
exuz: Otlarni boqish uchun yulaf zaxirasi yetarlicha edi.

def: Joy issiq va quruq, juda kam yomg'ir yog'adi.
ex: Not many plants grow in the arid desert.
exuz: Qurg'oqchil cho'lda o'simliklar kam o'sadi.

def: Muhim, ko'pincha katta va go'zal qurilgan cherkov.
ex: The large cathedral is full of people on Sunday mornings.
exuz: Katta sobor yakshanba ertalablari odamlarga to'la bo'ladi.

def: Vaziyat yaxshilanishi yoki yomonlashishi mumkin bo'lgan qiyin vaqt.
ex: The crisis was over and things returned to normal.
exuz: Inqiroz tugadi va hamma narsa odatiy holatga qaytdi.

def: Kimgadir biror narsaga ega bo'lishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik.
ex: Because the child was bad, she was deprived of her dessert after dinner.
exuz: Bola yomon bo'lgani uchun kechki ovqatdan keyin deserti berilmadi.

def: Uzoq vaqt oz yoki umuman yomg'ir yog'maydigan davr.
ex: After three months of drought, the vegetation and trees started dying.
exuz: Uch oylik qurg'oqchilikdan keyin o'simlik va daraxtlar qura boshladi.

def: Kimdir biror narsani qilishga yoki ega bo'lishga ruxsat etilgan.
ex: Only people who bought tickets were eligible to win a prize.
exuz: Faqat chipta sotib olgan odamlar sovrin yutish huquqiga ega edi.

def: Ma'lum vaqt ovqat yoki ichimliksiz yurish.
ex: In her religion, they fast for five days and then have a big feast.
exuz: Uning dinida ular besh kun ro'za tutib, keyin katta ziyofat qilishadi.

def: Norozi bo'lib gapirish.
ex: He grumbled about having to work late on Friday.
exuz: U juma kuni kech ishlashga to'g'ri kelgani haqida g'o'ldirandi.

def: Kimdir mamlakat yoki yerning markaziga boradi.
ex: The river curved inland near the campground.
exuz: Daryo lager yaqinida quruqlik ichkarisiga qarab burildi.

def: Havo yoki sirtdagi kichik suv tomchilari.
ex: If you breathe on a window, moisture from your breath collects on the glass.
exuz: Derazaga nafas olsangiz, nafasingizdagi namlik shishaga yig'iladi.

def: Boshqa narsaga qaramay sodir bo'ladigan narsa.
ex: She tried to keep the dog out of the mud, but it got dirty nonetheless.
exuz: U itni loydan uzoqroq tutmoqchi bo'ldi, lekin shunga qaramay u kirlandi.

def: Rasmiy, ko'pincha ommaviy va'da.
ex: Judges must take an oath to be fair to everyone in court.
exuz: Sudyalar sudda hammaga adolatli bo'lishga qasam ichishi kerak.

def: Katta yassi o'tloqli yer.
ex: The prairie was perfect for a farm because there were hills and trees.
exuz: Dasht ferma uchun juda mos edi, chunki u yerda tepaliklar va daraxtlar bor edi.

def: Yer toshloq va sayohat qilish qiyin.
ex: Their car couldn't make it far along the rugged roads.
exuz: Ularning mashinasi notekis yo'llarda uzoqqa bora olmadi.

def: Biror narsa juda oz miqdorda.
ex: When gasoline was scarce, we rode our bike to school instead of driving.
exuz: Benzin tanqis bo'lganda biz maktabga mashinada emas, velosipedda bordik.

def: Biror narsa haqida taxmin qilish.
ex: My sister looked at the sky and speculated that it would rain tomorrow.
exuz: Singlim osmonga qarab ertaga yomg'ir yog'adi deb taxmin qildi.

def: O'simlik yoki hayvon suvda yashaydi yoki o'sadi.
ex: The dolphin is an aquatic mammal.
exuz: Delfin — suvda yashovchi sutemizuvchi.

def: Yerning tirik mavjudotlar yashaydigan sirti va atmosferasi.
ex: Birds, trees, and worms all thrive in the biosphere.
exuz: Qushlar, daraxtlar va chuvalchanglar hammasi biosferada gullab-yashnaydi.

def: Biror narsa juda g'alati.
ex: My bizarre dreams make no sense to me when I am awake.
exuz: Uyg'oq paytimda g'alati tushlarim menga ma'nosiz tuyuladi.

def: Haroratni o'lchaydigan shkala.
ex: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius.
exuz: Suv nol daraja Selsiyda muzlaydi.

def: Biror narsa dag'al yuzaga ega.
ex: The coarse sweater made my skin itch.
exuz: Dag'al sviter terimni qichitdi.

def: Biror kishi ko'p vaqt birga o'tkazadigan odam.
ex: I always walk to school with my companion Frank.
exuz: Men maktabga doim hamrohim Frenk bilan piyoda boraman.

def: Ovqatni yutib, tana orqali o'tkazish.
ex: Allow some time for food to be digested before going swimming.
exuz: Suzishga borishdan oldin ovqat hazm bo'lishi uchun biroz vaqt bering.

def: Voqea davom etadigan vaqt.
ex: The girls watched television for the duration of the evening.
exuz: Qizlar butun oqshom davomida televizor ko'rishdi.

def: Atrof-muhit va tirik mavjudotlarni o'rganadigan fan.
ex: We study ecology to learn how to help improve the Earth.
exuz: Biz Yerni yaxshilashga qanday yordam berishni o'rganish uchun ekologiyani o'qiymiz.

def: Ta'sirli yoki qiyin yutuq yoki harakat.
ex: The elephant's standing up on one leg was a feat.
exuz: Filning bir oyog'ida turishi ajoyib ish edi.

def: Biror narsaning chegarasi yoki oxiri yo'q.
ex: Many scientists believe that the universe is infinite.
exuz: Ko'p olim koinot cheksiz deb hisoblaydi.

def: Atom yoki hujayraning markaziy qismi.
ex: The nucleus is made up of many tiny particles.
exuz: Yadro ko'plab mayda zarrachalardan tashkil topgan.

def: Ovqat olish uchun boshqa hayvonga yopishadigan mayda hayvon yoki o'simlik.
ex: The sick dog was covered in parasites.
exuz: Kasal it parazitlar bilan qoplangan edi.

def: Biror narsa muhim va yaxshi tanilgan.
ex: Queen Victoria was a prominent person in history.
exuz: Qirolicha Viktoriya tarixdagi mashhur shaxs edi.

def: Biror narsa ko'p marta takrorlanib, zerikarli bo'lib qoladi.
ex: Working on an assembly line making cars every day is a repetitive job.
exuz: Har kuni konveyerda mashina yig'ish — takrorlanuvchi ish.

def: Biror narsa jonli bo'lib, bola tug'a oladi.
ex: The reproductive system of a plant is simple.
exuz: O'simlikning ko'payish tizimi oddiy.

def: Joy hech qachon juda issiq yoki sovuq bo'lmaydi.
ex: In Peru, the weather is temperate and rarely gets too hot or cold.
exuz: Peruda ob-havo mo'tadil va kamdan-kam juda issiq yoki sovuq bo'ladi.

def: Yoqmaydigan narsani qabul qilish yoki boshqalarning tanlov erkinligiga yo'l qo'yish qobiliyati.
ex: Boxers have a high tolerance for pain.
exuz: Bokschilarning og'riqqa chidami yuqori.

def: Biror harakatning o'zingizga sodir bo'lishiga uchrash.
ex: The cancer patient undergoes treatments twice a week.
exuz: Saraton kasali haftada ikki marta davolanadi.

def: Odam zaif va himoyasiz bo'lsa.
ex: He felt very vulnerable when he was stranded in the desert.
exuz: U cho'lda qolib ketganda o'zini juda himoyasiz his qildi.

def: Biror narsa juda eski yoki zamon talabiga javob bermaydi.
ex: To be competitive, we must update our archaic equipment.
exuz: Raqobatbardosh bo'lish uchun eskirgan jihozlarimizni yangilashimiz kerak.

def: Musiqa asboblari va bezaklar yasash uchun ishlatiladigan metall.
ex: Brass is used to make musical instruments like trumpets.
exuz: Jez karnay kabi musiqa asboblarini yasash uchun ishlatiladi.

def: Xususiy kompaniyalar foyda uchun tovar ishlab chiqaradigan iqtisodiy tizim.
ex: Most economies in the world today are based on capitalism.
exuz: Bugun dunyodagi ko'p iqtisodiyotlar kapitalizmga asoslangan.

def: Katta mashinaning bir qismi.
ex: Computers have many different components, so they are complicated to build.
exuz: Kompyuterlarda ko'p turli qismlar bor, shuning uchun ularni yig'ish murakkab.

def: Kimdir boshqa narsaga tayanadigan holat.
ex: Young children have a dependence on their parents.
exuz: Kichik bolalar ota-onasiga qaram.

def: Kichraymoq yoki qisqartirmoq.
ex: As the economy got worse, my savings diminished.
exuz: Iqtisodiyot yomonlashgani sari jamg'armam kamaydi.

def: Noqulaylik.
ex: The drawback of having a car is that it is very expensive to maintain.
exuz: Mashina egalik qilishning kamchiligi — uni saqlash juda qimmat.

def: O'z fikrlaringizni boshqalarga majburlash.
ex: He imposes on his wife every morning by expecting her to make his breakfast.
exuz: U har ertalab xotinidan nonushta tayyorlashni kutib, unga yuk bo'ladi.

def: Xizmat yoki sotuv tovarlari ishlab chiqaradigan biznes turi.
ex: The tourist industry is doing well all around the world.
exuz: Turizm sohasi butun dunyoda yaxshi ishlamoqda.

def: Menejer yoki boshqaruvga aloqador narsa.
ex: Nancy has a managerial position at the bank.
exuz: Nensi bankda boshqaruv lavozimida ishlaydi.

def: Milodiy 650 va 1500-yillar orasidagi davrga oid narsa.
ex: We visited a castle that was built during medieval times.
exuz: Biz o'rta asrlarda qurilgan qal'aga bordik.

def: Yaxshiroq narsa chiqqani uchun endi ishlatilmaydi.
ex: Since computers became inexpensive, typewriters have become obsolete.
exuz: Kompyuterlar arzonlashgach, yozuv mashinkalari eskirdi.

def: Biror narsa tomonga qaratilgan.
ex: He is living a money-oriented lifestyle.
exuz: U pulga yo'nalgan hayot tarzida yashayapti.

def: Uch tomoni dengiz bilan o'ralgan katta quruqlik bo'lagi.
ex: The state of Florida is an example of a peninsula.
exuz: Florida shtati yarim orolga misol.

def: Odamga boshqalar qoyil qoladi yoki hurmat qiladi.
ex: The young actress gained much prestige after she won an award.
exuz: Yosh aktrisa mukofot yutgach, katta obro'-e'tibor qozondi.

def: Qismlar va butun orasidagi bog'liqlikni ko'rsatadigan miqdor.
ex: Only a small proportion of the people in this town actually work here.
exuz: Bu shahardagi odamlarning faqat kichik qismi haqiqatan shu yerda ishlaydi.

def: Biror narsa juda yangi yoki boshqacha.
ex: The president is planning to make some radical changes to the law.
exuz: Prezident qonunga ba'zi tub o'zgarishlar kiritishni rejalashtirmoqda.

def: Biror narsaning noto'g'ri ekanini isbotlash.
ex: The bank manager has refuted the claims that he lied to his customers.
exuz: Bank menejeri mijozlariga yolg'on gapirgani haqidagi da'volarni rad etdi.

def: Biror narsa juda ta'sirli ko'rinadi yoki eshitiladi.
ex: There was a spectacular fireworks display in the park at New Year.
exuz: Yangi yilda parkda ajoyib otashbozlik tomoshasi bo'ldi.

def: Gorizontal va vertikal iplar bilan mato yasash.
ex: We saw a woman weave a blanket on our vacation to South America.
exuz: Janubiy Amerikaga ta'tilimizda biz ayol adyol to'qiyotganini ko'rdik.

def: Biznesning moliyaviy hisoblarini yuritadigan odam.
ex: The accountant helped us keep track of our spending.
exuz: Buxgalter xarajatlarimizni kuzatib borishimizga yordam berdi.

def: Foyda uchun savdo va sanoatga pul tikadigan biznesmen.
ex: The capitalist invested in a factory that made wheat into cereal.
exuz: Kapitalist bug'doydan yorma yasaydigan zavodga sarmoya kiritdi.

def: Biror narsaga hurmat bo'lmaslik hissi.
ex: The judge had contempt for the wicked criminal.
exuz: Sudya yovuz jinoyatchini mensimas edi.

def: Yer ishlab chiqargan narsa.
ex: I had a good crop of onions this year.
exuz: Bu yil piyozdan yaxshi hosil oldim.

def: O'zingizni biror ishga ko'p vaqt va kuch sarflashga bag'ishlash.
ex: The nun dedicated herself to helping people in need.
exuz: Rohiba o'zini muhtoj odamlarga yordam berishga bag'ishladi.

def: Yo'l yoki dala yonida yerga kesilgan tor chuqurlik.
ex: When the car slid off of the road, it fell into the ditch.
exuz: Mashina yo'ldan sirpanib chiqib ketganda ariqqa tushib ketdi.

def: Kompaniya yoki biznes.
ex: My father owns an advertising enterprise.
exuz: Dadamning reklama korxonasi bor.

def: Kimgadir yoki nimagadir pul berish.
ex: The government financed the scientist's experiments with new weapons.
exuz: Hukumat olimning yangi qurollar bilan o'tkazgan tajribalarini moliyalashtirdi.

def: Kimdir biror narsaga qiziqmaydi.
ex: Lisa is indifferent toward school. She doesn't care what her final grades are.
exuz: Liza maktabga befarq. Uning yakuniy baholari qanday bo'lishi uni qiziqtirmaydi.

def: Ekinlar o'sishi uchun yerga suv berish.
ex: In dry climates, it is important to irrigate fields of crops.
exuz: Quruq iqlimda ekin dalalarini sug'orish muhim.

def: Biror narsani miqdor, o'lcham yoki ahamiyat jihatidan iloji boricha katta qilish.
ex: You should exercise regularly to maximize a healthy lifestyle.
exuz: Sog'lom hayot tarzini maksimal darajaga yetkazish uchun muntazam mashq qilishingiz kerak.

def: Biror narsa pulga aloqador.
ex: A strong monetary policy is important for a country to be successful.
exuz: Kuchli pul siyosati mamlakat muvaffaqiyati uchun muhim.

def: Yomon narsa bo'lishining oldini olish uchun qilingan ish.
ex: As a precaution, you should put on a heavy coat before going out in cold weather.
exuz: Ehtiyot chorasi sifatida sovuq havoda chiqishdan oldin qalin palto kiyishingiz kerak.

def: Muhimroq voqeadan oldin sodir bo'ladigan narsa.
ex: The runners must do well in the preliminary races to qualify for the final race.
exuz: Yuguruvchilar final poygasiga chiqish uchun dastlabki poygalarda yaxshi natija ko'rsatishi kerak.

def: Biror narsani suyuqlik bilan butunlay ho'l qilish.
ex: The sponge was saturated with soapy water and dripped all over the floor.
exuz: Shimgich sovunli suvga to'yinib, butun polga tomchiladi.

def: Biror narsaning bajarish yoki tushunish oson bo'lishi.
ex: We were able to find the house thanks to the simplicity of the directions.
exuz: Biz uyni yo'l ko'rsatmalari soddaligi tufayli topa oldik.

def: Urug'larni yerga ekish.
ex: He always sows his garden seeds in the springtime.
exuz: U bog' urug'larini doim bahorda ekadi.

def: Qazish uchun ishlatiladigan asbob.
ex: The gardener used her spade to make a hole for the new plant.
exuz: Bog'bon yangi o'simlik uchun chuqur qazishda belkurakdan foydalandi.

def: Qizil meva, lekin ko'pincha sabzavot sifatida yeyiladi. Salat va pasta sousida ishlatiladi.
ex: I like tomato sandwiches.
exuz: Men pomidorli sendvichlarni yoqtiraman.

def: Biror narsa yaqin kelajakda sodir bo'ladi.
ex: The kids were worried about their upcoming exam.
exuz: Bolalar yaqinlashib kelayotgan imtihonidan xavotirda edi.

def: Odamlar, jamiyat va madaniyatni o'rganadigan fan.
ex: In anthropology class, I learned about simple tools that ancient cultures used.
exuz: Antropologiya darsida qadimgi madaniyatlar ishlatgan oddiy asboblar haqida o'rgandim.

def: Ma'qullashni ko'rsatish uchun qo'l chapish.
ex: Everyone cheered and applauded Manny's efforts.
exuz: Hamma Menning harakatlarini olqishlab, qarsak chaldi.

def: Kimnidir ishga qo'yish.
ex: Two students were appointed to help the scientists with their research.
exuz: Ikki o'quvchi olimlarga tadqiqotda yordam berish uchun tayinlandi.

def: Narsalar yaxshi ishlasa yoki birga mavjud bo'la olsa.
ex: Jan and Fred are too different. They will never be compatible.
exuz: Jan va Fred juda boshqacha. Ular hech qachon mos kelmaydi.

def: Biror ishni yaxshi yoki samarali bajara olish qobiliyati.
ex: The job was easy because the group had enough competence to do it well.
exuz: Ish oson edi, chunki guruhda uni yaxshi bajarish uchun yetarli malaka bor edi.

def: Qaror qabul qilish uchun kimdir bilan muhokama qilish.
ex: I will have to confer with my wife before I can purchase a new car.
exuz: Yangi mashina sotib olishdan oldin xotinim bilan maslahatlashishim kerak.

def: Biror narsa uzilishsiz birin-ketin sodir bo'ladi.
ex: The king ruled for ten consecutive years.
exuz: Shoh ketma-ket o'n yil hukmronlik qildi.

def: Biror narsa aniq yoki batafsil emas, lekin foydali.
ex: She drew crude hearts on the ground to show how much she loved him.
exuz: U uni qanchalik yaxshi ko'rishini ko'rsatish uchun yerga oddiy yuraklar chizdi.

def: Barcha oltita yuzasi bir xil kvadrat bo'lgan jism.
ex: Please get me some ice cubes to put in my soda.
exuz: Iltimos, gazli suvimga solish uchun menga bir nechta muz bo'lagi keltiring.

def: Odamga qanday ishlayotgani haqida bildirilgan izohlar.
ex: I asked my boss for feedback on my work.
exuz: Men boshlig'imdan ishim haqida fikr-mulohaza so'radim.

def: Biror narsa haqida bilimning yo'qligi.
ex: When he failed the test, his ignorance of math was obvious.
exuz: U testdan yiqilganda uning matematikani bilmasligi ayon bo'ldi.

def: Biror narsa erkaklarga xos sifat.
ex: American football is usually considered a masculine sport.
exuz: Amerika futboli odatda erkaklarga xos sport hisoblanadi.

def: Odam yoki voqeani eslash uchun qurilgan inshoot.
ex: A large monument was built to honor the brave soldiers.
exuz: Jasur askarlarni ulug'lash uchun katta yodgorlik qurildi.

def: Odam juda baquvvat va kuchli.
ex: He exercised regularly so that his body could become muscular.
exuz: U tanasi mushakli bo'lishi uchun muntazam mashq qildi.

def: Odamning turish yoki o'tirish usuli.
ex: Your back will feel much better if you improve your posture.
exuz: Qad-qomatingizni yaxshilasangiz, belingiz ancha yaxshi bo'ladi.

def: Biror narsani ma'lum joyga qo'yish yoki qurish.
ex: The road was situated between the forest and the lake.
exuz: Yo'l o'rmon bilan ko'l orasida joylashgan edi.

def: Biror narsa to'g'ri bajarilayotganiga ishonch hosil qilish.
ex: Allen supervised the construction workers to ensure everyone's safety.
exuz: Allen hammaning xavfsizligini ta'minlash uchun qurilish ishchilarini nazorat qildi.

def: Ikki yarmi aynan bir xil bo'lish holati.
ex: The artist made sure to use perfect symmetry when painting the butterfly.
exuz: Rassom kapalakni chizayotganda mukammal simmetriyadan foydalanishga ishonch hosil qildi.

def: Teriga ignalar bilan doimiy chizilgan naqsh.
ex: The surfer had tattoos on both his arms.
exuz: Serfer ikkala qo'lida ham tatuirovkalari bor edi.

def: Kollejda bakalavr darajasi uchun o'qiyotgan talaba.
ex: She was excited to finish high school and enroll as an undergraduate in the fall.
exuz: U maktabni tugatib, kuzda bakalavr talabasi bo'lib o'qishga kirishdan hayajonda edi.

def: Kimgadir kerak yoki xohlagan hamma narsani berish.
ex: Bill was too sick to get out of bed, so his nurse catered to his needs.
exuz: Bill kasalligidan o'rnidan tura olmasdi, shuning uchun hamshira uning ehtiyojlarini qondirdi.

def: Kimdir boshqalarning ehtiyojlariga e'tibor beradi.
ex: The considerate boy gave his girlfriend a present to cheer her up when she was sad.
exuz: E'tiborli yigit qiz do'sti xafa bo'lganda uni xursand qilish uchun sovg'a berdi.

def: Ovqat yoki ichimlikni yeyish yoki ichish.
ex: These apples are too rotten for consumption.
exuz: Bu olmalar iste'mol qilish uchun juda chirigan.

def: Kimdir biror narsani baholaydigan yoki qaror qiladigan omillar.
ex: Before she got the job, she had to meet all the necessary criteria.
exuz: Ishga olinishidan oldin u barcha kerakli mezonlarga javob berishi kerak edi.

def: Non bo'lagining qattiq tashqi qismi.
ex: The little boy never ate the crust of his pizza.
exuz: Kichkina bola pitsasining qirrasini hech qachon yemasdi.

def: Kimgadir biror narsaga ega bo'lish yoki qilish huquqini berish.
ex: His golden ticket entitled him to sit in the front row at the concert.
exuz: Uning oltin chiptasi unga konsertda birinchi qatorda o'tirish huquqini berdi.

def: Odamlarni biror joyga xavfsiz hamroh bo'lib olib borish.
ex: Her bodyguards escorted her to the movie theater.
exuz: Qo'riqchilari uni kinoteatrgacha kuzatib borishdi.

def: Biror narsa tashqi qismga ulangan.
ex: It is warm inside my house, but the external temperature is freezing.
exuz: Uyim ichi iliq, lekin tashqi harorat muzlatuvchi.

def: Muayyan maqsad uchun mavjud bino.
ex: There are many educational facilities in big cities.
exuz: Katta shaharlarda ko'plab ta'lim muassasalari bor.

def: Aqliy yoki jismoniy qobiliyat.
ex: The boy's mental faculties impressed all of his teachers.
exuz: Bolaning aqliy qobiliyatlari barcha ustozlarini hayratga soldi.

def: Biror narsaning katta uyumi.
ex: After the building was torn down, all that was left was a heap of bricks.
exuz: Bino buzib tashlangach, faqat g'isht uyumi qoldi.

def: Yerning yarmi.
ex: In the northern hemisphere, the weather is usually warmest in July and August.
exuz: Shimoliy yarim sharda ob-havo odatda iyul va avgustda eng iliq bo'ladi.

def: Ko'pincha poyga yoki ov uchun ishlatiladigan it turi.
ex: The men took their hounds with them when they went on the hunting trip.
exuz: Erkaklar ov safariga ketayotganda ovchi itlarini olib ketishdi.

def: Biror narsa mehribon emas va odamlarni ahamiyatsiz his qildiradi.
ex: The boy felt scared on his first day at the big, impersonal high school.
exuz: Bola katta, sovuq o'rta maktabdagi birinchi kunida qo'rqib ketdi.

def: Biror narsa ustidan tilingizni yurgizish.
ex: He licked his ice cream before it melted.
exuz: U muzqaymog'ini erib ketishidan oldin yaladi.

def: Odamlar uylarida namoyish qiladigan chiroyli buyum.
ex: The woman kept some colorful ornaments on the shelves.
exuz: Ayol javonlarda rang-barang bezaklar saqlardi.

def: Ko'chada piyoda yurayotgan odam.
ex: Drivers should be careful when pedestrians are walking around.
exuz: Piyodalar yurganda haydovchilar ehtiyot bo'lishi kerak.

def: Xavf ostidagi odamlar xavfsiz joy topadigan joy.
ex: The church was made into a sanctuary for homeless people in the winter.
exuz: Cherkov qishda uysiz odamlar uchun panohga aylantirildi.

def: Biror narsani, masalan sport tadbirini, tomosha qiladigan odam.
ex: There were thousands of spectators at the big game.
exuz: Katta o'yinda minglab tomoshabin bor edi.

def: Kimgadir qichqirish.
ex: Someone yelled out his name.
exuz: Kimdir uning ismini baqirib chaqirdi.

def: Biror narsani yaxshiroq ko'rsatish uchun qo'shilgan narsa.
ex: The store sold colorful accessories like bags, sunglasses, and makeup.
exuz: Do'kon sumka, quyoshdan saqlovchi ko'zoynak va bo'yanish kabi rang-barang aksessuarlar sotardi.

def: Biror kishi sotib olgan yoki qandaydir yo'l bilan olgan narsa.
ex: Marty was happy with his new acquisition: a very fast bicycle.
exuz: Marti yangi xarididan — juda tez velosipeddan — xursand edi.

def: Qattiq qog'ozdan yasalgan material, ko'pincha qutilar yasash uchun.
ex: We packed our things into cardboard boxes and moved to our new home.
exuz: Biz narsalarimizni karton qutilarga solib, yangi uyimizga ko'chib o'tdik.

def: Tanlash kerak bo'lgan qiyin vaziyat.
ex: Choosing either the tastier or healthier drink proved to be quite a dilemma.
exuz: Mazali yoki foydaliroq ichimlikni tanlash ancha qiyin tanlov bo'lib chiqdi.

def: Biror narsada ko'p tafsilot bor.
ex: She gave the teacher an elaborate explanation of her project.
exuz: U ustoziga loyihasi haqida batafsil tushuntirish berdi.

def: Har bir tafsilotda to'g'ri.
ex: I know the exact location of the restaurant you mentioned before.
exuz: Siz avval aytgan restoranning aniq joyini bilaman.

def: Biror narsani osonroq qilish.
ex: To facilitate the meeting, Melissa used a simple computer program.
exuz: Yig'ilishni osonlashtirish uchun Melissa oddiy kompyuter dasturidan foydalandi.

def: Kemalar guruhi.
ex: The fleet of ships spent a few days at the dock.
exuz: Kemalar floti dokda bir necha kun turdi.

def: Xaritadagi joylarni topish uchun raqam va harflar bor kataklar naqshi.
ex: We located our town using the grid.
exuz: Biz shahrimizni setka yordamida topdik.

def: Mahsulotni boshqa mamlakatdan olib kelish.
ex: Foods that have been imported are usually more expensive.
exuz: Import qilingan ovqatlar odatda qimmatroq bo'ladi.

def: Boshqa ma'lumotga qarab biror narsa rost deb qaror qilish.
ex: By the position of the sun in the sky, she inferred that it was noon.
exuz: Quyoshning osmondagi o'rniga qarab u tush bo'ldi deb xulosa chiqardi.

def: Biror narsani havo bilan to'ldirish.
ex: I helped him inflate the balloons.
exuz: Men unga sharlarni shishirishda yordam berdim.

def: Biror narsa odam bilan tug'ilgan va o'rganilmagan.
ex: He had the innate desire to please his teachers.
exuz: Unda ustozlarini xursand qilishga tug'ma istak bor edi.

def: Kesilganda sovuq va silliq tuyuladigan tosh turi.
ex: The large house had floors made of marble.
exuz: Katta uyning pollari marmardan edi.

def: Yelkanni ushlab turuvchi kemadagi uzun ustun.
ex: The mast held both sails of the ship upright.
exuz: Machta kemaning ikkala yelkanini tik ushlab turardi.

def: Oshqozoningiz yomon bo'lgan tuyg'u.
ex: The doctor said the medicine would help get rid of her nausea.
exuz: Shifokor dori uning ko'ngil aynishini yo'qotishga yordam berishini aytdi.

def: Mamlakat dengiz floti yoki harbiy kemalariga oid narsa.
ex: The country sent all of its naval forces to protect them.
exuz: Mamlakat ularni himoya qilish uchun butun harbiy-dengiz kuchlarini yubordi.

def: Odatda yumshoq materialdan yasalgan kichik, egiluvchan xalta.
ex: I keep my money in a small pouch.
exuz: Men pulimni kichik xaltachada saqlayman.

def: Biror narsa butunlay ho'l.
ex: Leigh's hair became saturated in the rainstorm.
exuz: Lining sochi yomg'irda butunlay ho'l bo'ldi.

def: Biror narsani zamonaviyroq qilish harakati.
ex: My phone is downloading a software update.
exuz: Telefonim dasturiy ta'minot yangilanishini yuklab olmoqda.

def: Boshqalarga qonun haqida maslahat beradigan odam.
ex: The attorney appeared in front of the judge for me.
exuz: Advokat men uchun sudya oldida chiqdi.

def: Biror narsa uzoq vaqt qayta-qayta sodir bo'ladi.
ex: He had chronic pain in his chest and needed to see a doctor.
exuz: Uning ko'kragida surunkali og'riq bor edi va shifokorga ko'rinishi kerak edi.

def: Odamlarga qoidalarga amal qilishda yordam beradigan tarbiya.
ex: One of the teacher's jobs is to teach her students discipline.
exuz: Ustozning vazifalaridan biri — o'quvchilarga intizom o'rgatish.

def: Tashkilotga biror narsa beradigan odam.
ex: He was proud to be a blood donor.
exuz: U qon donori bo'lganidan faxrlanardi.

def: Siz bilan ish yoki xususiyatni baham ko'radigan odam.
ex: All of my fellow patients at the hospital have also complained about the food.
exuz: Kasalxonadagi barcha hamxonalarim ham ovqatdan shikoyat qilishgan.

def: Yolg'on bo'lishi mumkin, lekin baribir muhokama qilinadigan ma'lumot.
ex: The friends exchanged gossip about the people they knew in school.
exuz: Do'stlar maktabda tanigan odamlari haqida mish-mish almashishdi.

def: O'quv kurslarini tugatib, imtihondan o'tish.
ex: At the end of the spring, my friends and I will graduate from high school.
exuz: Bahor oxirida do'stlarim bilan maktabni bitiramiz.

def: Jamoat joylarida yozilgan so'zlar yoki rasmlar.
ex: The wall was covered with colorful graffiti.
exuz: Devor rang-barang graffitilar bilan qoplangan edi.

def: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir himoya qiladigan odam.
ex: The librarians are the guardians of the books.
exuz: Kutubxonachilar — kitoblar qo'riqchisi.

def: Kimningdir jinoyat yoki yomon ish qilganini ko'rsatish.
ex: The man was implicated in the theft at the store.
exuz: Erkak do'kondagi o'g'irlikka aralashganlikda gumon qilindi.

def: Odamning oilasi va qarindoshlari.
ex: His kin were all farmers.
exuz: Uning qarindoshlari hammasi dehqon edi.

def: Sportda qoidalarga rioya qilinishini ta'minlaydigan odam.
ex: The soccer player didn't agree with the referee.
exuz: Futbolchi hakam bilan kelishmadi.

def: Biror narsani butunlay kesib o'tish.
ex: He severed the string using scissors.
exuz: U ipni qaychi bilan kesib tashladi.

def: Asbob yoki qurolning dastasi.
ex: The golf club had a long wooden shaft that he held in his hands.
exuz: Golf tayog'ining qo'lida ushlagan uzun yog'och dastasi bor edi.

def: Pichoq kabi o'tkir narsaning uchi bilan kesish.
ex: He stabbed the fork into the potato and passed it to his daughter.
exuz: U vilkani kartoshkaga sanchib, qiziga uzatdi.

def: O'sish yoki faoliyatga sabab bo'ladigan narsa.
ex: Having a lot of money is a stimulus for people to buy more things.
exuz: Ko'p pulga ega bo'lish odamlarni ko'proq narsa sotib olishga undaydi.

def: Jinoyatda biror narsa mumkin yoki rost degan his.
ex: The police had a suspicion that the driver had stolen the purse.
exuz: Politsiya haydovchi hamyonni o'g'irlagan deb gumon qildi.

def: Biror narsani to'xtatish yoki oxiriga yetkazish.
ex: The trip was terminated after the car broke down.
exuz: Mashina buzilgach, safar to'xtatildi.

def: Kitob, film yoki rasmning asosiy mavzusi.
ex: The students discussed the book's theme in class.
exuz: O'quvchilar sinfda kitob mavzusini muhokama qilishdi.

def: Maktabda o'qish uchun to'lanadigan pul miqdori.
ex: University tuitions have increased by 50 percent in the last five years.
exuz: Universitet o'qish haqlari so'nggi besh yilda 50 foizga oshdi.

def: Kimdir doim urishishni yoki bahslashishni xohlaydi.
ex: Nobody liked to play games with him because he was always too aggressive.
exuz: U doim juda tajovuzkor bo'lgani uchun hech kim u bilan o'ynashni yoqtirmasdi.

def: Urush mahbuslariga berilgan kechirim.
ex: She was denied amnesty for her involvement in the war.
exuz: Uning urushdagi ishtiroki uchun avf berilmadi.

def: Odamlar sport va konsertlarni tomosha qiladigan bino.
ex: The new arena was all set to hold the championship match.
exuz: Yangi arena chempionat o'yinini o'tkazishga to'liq tayyor edi.

def: Jamoat tadbirlari uchun ishlatiladigan katta bino.
ex: People have gathered at the school auditorium to watch the play.
exuz: Odamlar spektaklni ko'rish uchun maktab zaliga yig'ilishdi.

def: Mahbus.
ex: The guards told the captive that there was no way he could escape the prison.
exuz: Qo'riqchilar asirga qamoqdan qochishning iloji yo'qligini aytishdi.

def: Ikki odam yoki guruh orasidagi urush.
ex: The two warriors were locked in combat.
exuz: Ikki jangchi o'zaro jangda edi.

def: Biror narsa oddiy.
ex: There is nothing commonplace about the way Morris dresses.
exuz: Morrisning kiyinish usulida hech qanday oddiylik yo'q.

def: Qamoqxona yoki zavod kabi o'ralgan joy.
ex: The workers waited outside the compound for the gates of the factory to open.
exuz: Ishchilar zavod darvozasi ochilishini hudud tashqarisida kutishdi.

def: Harbiy kuchlarning bir bo'limi.
ex: The army had a corps of archers who trained apart from the regular soldiers.
exuz: Armiyada oddiy askarlardan alohida mashq qiladigan kamonchilar korpusi bor edi.

def: Kimnidir biror narsaga e'tibor qaratishdan to'xtatish.
ex: The phone call distracted him so much that he forgot all about his homework.
exuz: Telefon qo'ng'irog'i uni shunchalik chalg'itdiki, u uy vazifasini butunlay unutdi.

def: Kimdir gapira olmaydi.
ex: She did not share the secret. She remained as silent as if she were dumb.
exuz: U sirni oshkor qilmadi. U soqovdek jim qoldi.

def: Dushman yoki raqib.
ex: It was hard to believe that anyone could be his foe.
exuz: Hech kim uning dushmani bo'lishi mumkinligiga ishonish qiyin edi.

def: Biror narsani notekis bo'laklarga kesish.
ex: My uncle used the ax to hack the tree into many logs.
exuz: Amakim daraxtni ko'p kundaga chopish uchun boltadan foydalandi.

def: Jimlikda diqqatni jamlash yoki chuqur o'ylash.
ex: She liked to meditate for several hours each day.
exuz: U har kuni bir necha soat meditatsiya qilishni yoqtirardi.

def: Biror narsa yoki kimnidir o'tkir narsa bilan ozgina kesish.
ex: While cutting the carrots, the cook nicked his finger with the edge of his knife.
exuz: Sabzi to'g'rayotganda oshpaz pichoq qirrasi bilan barmog'ini ozgina kesib oldi.

def: Zo'ravonlik keltirib chiqarish uchun kimnidir ataylab bezovta qilish.
ex: The older boy provoked Paul by calling him mean names.
exuz: Katta bola Polni yomon laqablar bilan chaqirib jahlini chiqardi.

def: Faoliyat yoki qiziqishning har qanday sohasi.
ex: He was not very active in the realm of business.
exuz: U biznes sohasida unchalik faol emas edi.

def: Hukmdor boshqargan vaqt davri.
ex: The emperor's reign lasted for only two years.
exuz: Imperatorning hukmronligi atigi ikki yil davom etdi.

def: Suv va havo tufayli temir narsalarda hosil bo'ladigan qizil-jigarrang qoplama.
ex: The old metal gate would not swing because the hinges were covered in rust.
exuz: Eski temir darvoza ochilmasdi, chunki ilmoqlari zang bilan qoplangan edi.

def: Biror narsaga sig'inadi va hurmat qilinadi.
ex: One religion in India will not harm cows because it believes that they are sacred.
exuz: Hindistondagi bir din sigirlarni muqaddas deb bilgani uchun ularga zarar yetkazmaydi.

def: Biror narsa go'zallikka muhabbat bilan bog'liq.
ex: The dresses were noteworthy for their aesthetic design.
exuz: Ko'ylaklar estetik dizayni bilan e'tiborga loyiq edi.

def: Kimdir o'zini boshqalardan muhimroq deb o'ylaydi.
ex: He is very arrogant. Even though he's not the boss, he tells everyone what to do.
exuz: U juda takabbur. Boshliq bo'lmasa ham, hammaga nima qilishni aytadi.

def: Odam bir narsani boshqasidan ko'proq yoqtirishi.
ex: The mothers had a natural bias for their own child's picture.
exuz: Onalar o'z farzandining suratiga tabiiy moyillikka ega edi.

def: Daryo oqib o'tadigan tik devorli tor vodiy.
ex: The canyon was so deep that the ground inside was covered in shadow.
exuz: Kanyon shu qadar chuqur ediki, uning tubi soya bilan qoplangan edi.

def: Oqim yoki kichik daryo.
ex: Only small fish lived in the shallow waters of the creek.
exuz: Soyning sayoz suvida faqat mayda baliqlar yashardi.

def: Teshik ochish uchun aylanadigan uchi bor asbob.
ex: The carpenter used the drill to make several holes in the wood.
exuz: Duradgor yog'ochda bir necha teshik ochish uchun parmadan foydalandi.

def: Biznesning bosh boshqaruvchisi.
ex: After twenty years at the company, he finally became the executive.
exuz: Kompaniyada yigirma yil ishlagandan keyin u nihoyat rahbar bo'ldi.

def: Juda qattiq charchoq hissi.
ex: After three days with little sleep, she was feeling a lot of fatigue.
exuz: Uch kun kam uxlagandan keyin u qattiq charchoqni his qilardi.

def: Biror narsada, ayniqsa tog' yoki tepalikda, keskin ko'tarilish.
ex: This mountain has one of the steepest inclines in the world.
exuz: Bu tog'da dunyodagi eng tik qiyaliklardan biri bor.

def: Biror narsa yoqimli emas.
ex: The rotten apple left a nasty taste inside her mouth.
exuz: Chirigan olma uning og'zida yoqimsiz ta'm qoldirdi.

def: Biror narsadan xabardor bo'lish.
ex: He was talking loudly, so he did not perceive that the music had stopped.
exuz: U baland ovozda gapirayotgan edi, shuning uchun musiqa to'xtaganini sezmadi.

def: Maymun, odamsimon maymun va odamlarni o'z ichiga oluvchi sutemizuvchilar turi.
ex: Primates use their hands for such tasks as swinging from branches.
exuz: Primatlar qo'llarini shoxlarda tebranish kabi ishlarda ishlatadi.

def: Biror narsa sodda, asosiy va unchalik rivojlanmagan.
ex: The computers of the 1980s are primitive compared to those of today.
exuz: 1980-yillardagi kompyuterlar bugungilarga qaraganda ibtidoiy.

def: Odam yoki narsa haqida umumiy, lekin ko'pincha noto'g'ri g'oya.
ex: There's a stereotype that pigs are dirty animals. But they are rather clean.
exuz: Cho'chqalar iflos hayvon degan stereotip bor. Lekin ular ancha toza.

def: Biror narsa uni yopishtiradigan modda bilan qoplangan.
ex: Place the sticky part of the tape against the paper, so it will cling to the wall.
exuz: Lentaning yopishqoq tomonini qog'ozga qo'ying, shunda u devorga yopishadi.

def: Guruh bo'lib yashaydigan va yog'ochni yeydigan hasharot.
ex: The wood we found was full of termites.
exuz: Biz topgan yog'och termitlarga to'la edi.

def: Biror narsa boshqa narsaning natijasida sodir bo'lishini bildiradi.
ex: He didn't score a goal, thereby ending his chance at setting a record.
exuz: U gol urmadi va shu bilan rekord o'rnatish imkoniyatini yo'qotdi.

def: Yovvoyi hududda piyoda yurish uchun yo'l.
ex: A narrow trail cut through the field and over the hills.
exuz: Tor so'qmoq dala orqali va tepaliklar ustidan o'tardi.

def: Daraxt yoki butadan chiqqan qisqa va ingichka shox.
ex: They started the fire with a handful of dry twigs.
exuz: Ular olovni bir hovuch quruq novdalar bilan yoqishdi.

def: Odam yoki guruhning sog'lig'i va baxti.
ex: Having plenty of clean water is necessary for the welfare of people.
exuz: Toza suvning ko'pligi odamlar farovonligi uchun zarur.

def: Biror ish boshqa odam uchun qilinadi.
ex: The original speaker was sick, so his son gave the speech on his behalf.
exuz: Asl notiq kasal edi, shuning uchun uning o'g'li nutqni uning nomidan so'zladi.

def: Tez tepaga-pastga yoki yonma-yon harakatlanish.
ex: The tiny bird flapped its wings and ate from the flowers.
exuz: Kichkina qush qanot qoqib, gullardan oziqlandi.

def: Juda sekin harakatlanadigan katta muz bo'lagi.
ex: The North Pole is covered by a huge glacier.
exuz: Shimoliy qutb ulkan muzlik bilan qoplangan.

def: Globus Yerni anglatadi.
ex: Water covers most of the globe.
exuz: Suv Yer sharining ko'p qismini qoplaydi.

def: Biror narsa yerga tekis va bir xil sathda.
ex: The Russian flag has three horizontal stripes of white, blue, and red.
exuz: Rossiya bayrog'ida oq, ko'k va qizil uchta gorizontal yo'l bor.

def: Past, uzluksiz ovoz chiqarish.
ex: The man hummed his favorite song.
exuz: Erkak sevimli qo'shig'ini xirgoyi qildi.

def: Biror narsa zaxirasi.
ex: Gwen was checking the inventory to make sure we had what we needed.
exuz: Gven bizda kerakli narsa borligiga ishonch hosil qilish uchun zaxirani tekshirmoqda edi.

def: Fikr yoki his boshqalarga bildirilmaydi.
ex: She had an inward feeling of guilt when she lied to her mother.
exuz: U onasiga yolg'on gapirganda ichida aybdorlik tuyg'usini his qildi.

def: Bir bo'lak qilib pishirilgan non.
ex: Could you please buy a loaf of bread for sandwiches?
exuz: Iltimos, sendvichlar uchun bir bo'lak non sotib olib bera olasizmi?

def: Xudolar bilan gaplashib, kelajak haqida maslahat beradigan odam.
ex: The king went to the oracle to ask if going to war was a good idea.
exuz: Shoh urushga borish yaxshi fikrmi, deb so'rash uchun folbinga bordi.

def: Uzluksiz egri yo'l bo'ylab biror narsa atrofida harakatlanish.
ex: The Moon orbits the Earth.
exuz: Oy Yer atrofida aylanadi.

def: Vaziyatning umumiy tavsifi.
ex: My brother gave me an overview of the important parts of the book.
exuz: Akam menga kitobning muhim qismlari haqida umumiy sharh berdi.

def: Biror narsani ommaga chiqishidan oldin ko'rish imkoniyati.
ex: The band played us a preview of their new song.
exuz: Guruh bizga yangi qo'shig'ining oldindan namunasini ijro etdi.

def: Biror narsa vaqt yoki tartibda avval sodir bo'lgan.
ex: He turned back to the previous page to read the paragraph again.
exuz: U xatboshini yana o'qish uchun oldingi sahifaga qaytdi.

def: Biror narsani yetkazib berish.
ex: Each student was provided with a test and three sharp pencils.
exuz: Har bir o'quvchiga test va uchta o'tkir qalam berildi.

def: Bir martadan ko'p sodir bo'lish.
ex: Burglaries seem to recur over and over in our neighborhood.
exuz: Mahallamizda o'g'irliklar qayta-qayta takrorlanayotganga o'xshaydi.

def: Biror narsa muayyan odam yoki vaziyat uchun muhim.
ex: The 30-year-old book about politics is still relevant to our society today.
exuz: Siyosat haqidagi 30 yillik kitob hali ham jamiyatimiz uchun dolzarb.

def: Muayyan guruh yoki jamiyat o'tkazadigan an'anaviy marosim.
ex: Special masks are worn during the rite when a new baby is born.
exuz: Yangi chaqaloq tug'ilganda marosim paytida maxsus niqoblar taqiladi.

def: Jarayonni to'xtatib, keyinroq davom ettirish.
ex: If you give the car a push, it won't stall.
exuz: Mashinani turtsangiz, u to'xtab qolmaydi.

def: Biror narsa haqiqiy emas yoki tabiat qonunlari bilan tushuntirib bo'lmaydi.
ex: The dragon had supernatural powers, such as flying and breathing fire.
exuz: Ajdahoda uchish va olov purkash kabi g'ayritabiiy kuchlar bor edi.

def: Baliq va suv osti hayvonlari saqlanadigan joy.
ex: We took a trip to the aquarium and saw a scary shark.
exuz: Biz akvariumga sayohat qilib, qo'rqinchli akulani ko'rdik.

def: Biror narsa reja yoki tizimga asoslanmagan, shuning uchun tasodifiy tuyuladi.
ex: The classroom had many arbitrary rules that confused me.
exuz: Sinfda meni chalkashtirgan ko'p o'zboshimcha qoidalar bor edi.

def: Odamning o'zi yozgan haqiqiy hayot hikoyasi.
ex: I read an autobiography about my favorite entertainer.
exuz: Men sevimli san'atkorim haqida uning o'zi yozgan tarjimai holni o'qidim.

def: Odatiy yoki xushmuomala hisoblangan xulq-atvor.
ex: In the US, a popular convention is to shake hands when you meet someone.
exuz: AQShda mashhur odat — kimnidir uchratganda qo'l siqish.

def: Kimdir muhtojlarga mehribon va yordam beradi.
ex: The operator was gracious enough to help me find the number.
exuz: Operator menga raqamni topishda yordam berishga yetarlicha mehribon edi.

def: Biror narsani yaxshiroq qilish.
ex: He studied hard to improve his test scores from the previous year.
exuz: U test ballarini o'tgan yilgidan yaxshilash uchun qattiq o'qidi.

def: Biror narsani issiqlik, sovuq yoki shovqindan himoya qilish.
ex: People can conserve energy by insulating their houses.
exuz: Odamlar uylarini izolyatsiya qilib energiya tejashi mumkin.

def: Odam yoki narsaga qiziqish uyg'otish.
ex: Her mysterious past intrigued her new friend.
exuz: Uning sirli o'tmishi yangi do'stini qiziqtirdi.

def: Uzoq vaqt yashash qobiliyati.
ex: Sea turtles have an amazing longevity.
exuz: Dengiz toshbaqalarining umri ajoyib darajada uzoq.

def: Biror narsani yo'qotish.
ex: I misplaced my wallet, and I didn't find it until a week later.
exuz: Men hamyonimni qo'yib unutdim va uni bir haftadan keyingina topdim.

def: Bolalar yomon xulq qilsa yoki aytganini qilmasa.
ex: The boy had to go to his room because he was being naughty.
exuz: Bola yaramaslik qilgani uchun xonasiga borishga majbur bo'ldi.

def: Muayyan jamiyatda odatiy hisoblanadigan xulq-atvor usuli.
ex: Wearing a heavy coat all summer is not considered a norm.
exuz: Butun yoz qalin palto kiyish me'yor hisoblanmaydi.

def: Qizil-jigarrang juni va uzun qo'llari bor katta maymun.
ex: Orangutans use their long arms to swing from trees.
exuz: Orangutanlar uzun qo'llari bilan daraxtlarda tebranadi.

def: Biror narsaga ko'tarish mumkin bo'lganidan ko'proq narsa solish.
ex: If you overload the truck, it might crash.
exuz: Yuk mashinasini ortiqcha yuklasangiz, u halokatga uchrashi mumkin.

def: Evaziga hech narsa kutmasdan boshqalarga yordam berish.
ex: The wealthy business owner is well known for his acts of philanthropy.
exuz: Boy biznes egasi xayriya ishlari bilan mashhur.

def: Biror narsa haqida faktlarni bilish uchun savol berish.
ex: The bank probed into his financial history to see if he qualified for a loan.
exuz: Bank u kreditga loyiqmi-yo'qmi bilish uchun uning moliyaviy tarixini surishtirdi.

def: Biror narsani oladigan odam.
ex: I was the recipient of four phone calls today.
exuz: Bugun men to'rtta telefon qo'ng'irog'ini oldim.

def: Tuxum qo'yadigan va tanasi tangachalar bilan qoplangan sovuq qonli hayvon.
ex: Lizards are my favorite type of reptile.
exuz: Kaltakesaklar mening sevimli sudralib yuruvchilarim.

def: Yaxshi va muvaffaqiyatli, sog'lom yoki kuchli bo'lish.
ex: He may be an old man, but he continues to thrive.
exuz: U keksa odam bo'lishi mumkin, lekin gullab-yashnashda davom etmoqda.

def: Biror narsa uzun voqealar qatorining yakuniy natijasi yoki maqsadi.
ex: By trying hard in school, I will reach my ultimate goal of becoming a doctor.
exuz: Maktabda qattiq harakat qilib, men shifokor bo'lish yakuniy maqsadimga erishaman.

def: Biror narsa juda eski va noyob, shuning uchun qimmatli.
ex: My grandmother's antique rocking chair is worth a lot of money.
exuz: Buvimning antiqa tebranma kreslosi juda qimmat turadi.

def: Ish yoki mukofot uchun ko'rib chiqilishni so'rab ariza yozgan odam.
ex: Lots of applicants came into the store when the job position became available.
exuz: Ish o'rni ochilganda do'konga ko'p nomzod keldi.

def: Odamlar yasagan, tarixiy jihatdan qiziqarli eski buyum.
ex: We studied artifacts from an ancient Chinese settlement.
exuz: Biz qadimgi Xitoy aholi punktidan topilgan buyumlarni o'rgandik.

def: Biror narsa soxta yoki nusxa emas.
ex: We ate authentic Italian food on our vacation to Rome.
exuz: Biz Rimga ta'tilda haqiqiy italyancha ovqat yedik.

def: Bir qator voqealarning sodir bo'lgan vaqt tartibi.
ex: We learned the chronology of World War II in history class.
exuz: Biz tarix darsida Ikkinchi jahon urushi xronologiyasini o'rgandik.

def: Boshqa mamlakat bilan ishlaydigan davlat vakili.
ex: The Spanish diplomat discussed trade issues with officials in Peru.
exuz: Ispaniyalik diplomat Peru mansabdorlari bilan savdo masalalarini muhokama qildi.

def: Uzoq davr yoki buyuk voqea haqidagi uzun kitob, she'r yoki film.
ex: The poet wrote an epic about the great discoveries of the past thousand years.
exuz: Shoir so'nggi ming yildagi buyuk kashfiyotlar haqida doston yozdi.

def: Kattaroq asardan olingan qisqa yozuv yoki musiqa bo'lagi.
ex: I didn't listen to the entire symphony online, but I did play an excerpt.
exuz: Men simfoniyaning hammasini onlayn tinglamadim, lekin bir parchasini eshitdim.

def: Tarixdan oldingi hayvon yoki o'simlikning qattiq qoldiqlari.
ex: The expert arranged the fossils to build the skeleton of the dinosaur.
exuz: Mutaxassis dinozavr skeletini yasash uchun toshga aylangan qoldiqlarni joylashtirdi.

def: Kimnidir uyaltirish va xijolat qilish.
ex: I was humiliated when I tripped and fell down in front of the whole school.
exuz: Butun maktab oldida qoqilib yiqilganimda sharmanda bo'ldim.

def: She'r ko'p his-tuyg'ularni ifodalasa.
ex: I enjoy reading and creating my own lyric poetry.
exuz: Men o'zimning lirik she'rlarimni o'qish va yaratishni yoqtiraman.

def: Eng yuksak buyuklik yoki hokimiyat.
ex: The majesty of the old castle amazed the tourists who came to see it.
exuz: Eski qal'aning ulug'vorligi uni ko'rgani kelgan sayyohlarni hayratda qoldirdi.

def: Mamlakatni meros huquqi bilan boshqaradigan odam.
ex: The monarch lived in a beautiful palace with a grand gate.
exuz: Monarx katta darvozali go'zal saroyda yashardi.

def: Biror narsadan oldin bo'lish.
ex: The hurricane was preceded by a moment of still wind and clear sky.
exuz: Dovuldan oldin shamolsiz va ochiq osmonli lahza bo'lgan edi.

def: Biror ishni to'g'ri vaqtda qilish yoki yetib kelish.
ex: My mother hates being late. She is the most punctual person I know.
exuz: Onam kechikishni yomon ko'radi. U men bilgan eng vaqtida keladigan odam.

def: Odamlarni tashkilotga qo'shilish yoki ishlash uchun tanlash.
ex: We successfully recruited someone to be the new manager.
exuz: Biz yangi menejer bo'ladigan odamni muvaffaqiyatli yolladik.

def: Do'konga buyum qaytarilganda odamga qaytarib beriladigan pul.
ex: I asked for a refund because the shoes I bought were too tight.
exuz: Men sotib olgan poyabzalim juda tor bo'lgani uchun pulni qaytarishni so'radim.

def: Odamlar yoki narsalarning rasmiy ro'yxati yoki yozuvi.
ex: At a wedding, there is a register for all of the guests to sign.
exuz: To'yda hamma mehmonlar imzo qo'yishi uchun ro'yxat bo'ladi.

def: Yaxshi ishlar tufayli yaxshi tanilgan bo'lish sifati.
ex: Michael is a singer of great renown in New Zealand.
exuz: Maykl Yangi Zelandiyada katta shuhratga ega qo'shiqchi.

def: Fil, yovvoyi cho'chqa yoki morjning uzun, egri, uchli tishi.
ex: Sadly, some people hunt elephants and remove their tusks to sell them.
exuz: Afsuski, ba'zi odamlar fillarni ovlab, ularning tishlarini sotish uchun olib qo'yadi.

def: Boshqa narsa bilan bir vaqtda va bir joyda mavjud bo'lish.
ex: Our pets coexist in our home with few or no problems.
exuz: Uy hayvonlarimiz uyimizda deyarli muammosiz birga yashaydi.

def: Biror narsani tasavvur qila olish yoki ishonish.
ex: The child could not conceive the actual size of the Earth.
exuz: Bola Yerning haqiqiy o'lchamini tasavvur qila olmadi.

def: Kimdir yoki nimadir halol deb hisoblanmaydi.
ex: The police thought that the man's description of the crime was dubious.
exuz: Politsiya erkakning jinoyat haqidagi tavsifini shubhali deb hisobladi.

def: Odamning o'z qadr-qimmati haqidagi tuyg'usi.
ex: Kelly's ego made her think that she was some kind of a superhero.
exuz: Kellining manmanligi uni qandaydir superqahramonman deb o'ylashga majbur qildi.

def: Tortilganda cho'ziladigan rezina.
ex: He attached the elastic bungee to his legs before he jumped off the platform.
exuz: U platformadan sakrashdan oldin elastik arqonni oyoqlariga bog'ladi.

def: Biror narsani, ayniqsa yangi yoki original ishni, qilishga urinish.
ex: The company's new advertising endeavor ended in a horrible failure.
exuz: Kompaniyaning yangi reklama urinishi dahshatli muvaffaqiyatsizlik bilan tugadi.

def: Biror narsaning sirtiga naqsh yoki so'zlarni o'yib yozish.
ex: The couple engraved their names onto the old pine tree.
exuz: Juftlik ismlarini eski qarag'ay daraxtiga o'yib yozdi.

def: Yerni qazib, biror narsa izlash.
ex: The team wishes to excavate the site in hope of finding fossils.
exuz: Jamoa qazilma qoldiqlarni topish umidida joyni qazishni xohlaydi.

def: Biror narsa qattiq va notekis shakl yoki qirraga ega.
ex: The swimmer was hurt when he fell on the jagged rocks.
exuz: Suzuvchi notekis toshlarga yiqilganda jarohatlandi.

def: Muayyan narsa sodir bo'ladigan kichik hudud yoki joy.
ex: The spa was the perfect locale for my mother to relax and enjoy her vacation.
exuz: Spa onam dam olib, ta'tildan zavqlanishi uchun mukammal joy edi.

def: Katta o'lchamni bildiradi.
ex: This was a discovery of great magnitude.
exuz: Bu juda katta ahamiyatga ega kashfiyot edi.

def: Ma'lum shakllarni yasash uchun ishlatiladigan ichi bo'sh idish.
ex: Using a cupcake mold will ensure that they come out just right.
exuz: Keks qolipidan foydalanish ularning aynan to'g'ri chiqishini ta'minlaydi.

def: Biror narsa ochiq va bevosita.
ex: Everyone knew that the boy's story was an outright lie.
exuz: Hamma bolaning hikoyasi ochiq-oydin yolg'on ekanini bilardi.

def: Hudud, joy yoki narsaning chetki qismi.
ex: A beautiful floral pattern is on the periphery of the stationery.
exuz: Yozuv qog'ozining chetida chiroyli gulli naqsh bor.

def: Qurisa qotib qoladigan silliq pasta.
ex: He used plaster to fill in the cracks in the old walls.
exuz: U eski devorlardagi yoriqlarni to'ldirish uchun suvoqdan foydalandi.

def: Qazish uchun ishlatiladigan uzun dastali asbob.
ex: The boy grabbed his shovel and got all of the snow off of the sidewalk.
exuz: Bola belkurakni olib, piyodalar yo'lagidagi butun qorni tozaladi.

def: Biror narsa tanadagi suyaklarga tegishli.
ex: We studied the skeletal system in anatomy class.
exuz: Biz anatomiya darsida skelet tizimini o'rgandik.

def: Noqulay, rejasiz tarzda harakatlanish.
ex: She stumbles a lot when she is drunk.
exuz: U mast bo'lganda ko'p qoqiladi.

def: Oyog'ingizning yuqori yarmi.
ex: He suffered a serious thigh injury.
exuz: U sonining jiddiy jarohatidan azob chekdi.

def: Biror narsa yoki kimdir zo'ravon va shafqatsiz.
ex: The vicious dog tried to bite the small child.
exuz: Shafqatsiz it kichkina bolani tishlamoqchi bo'ldi.

def: Uy tomi ostidagi xona.
ex: There were two windows in their attic.
exuz: Ularning cherdog'ida ikkita deraza bor edi.

def: Biror narsaning qalin, qattiq bo'lagi.
ex: When they broke open the rock, they saw it was filled with chunks of gold.
exuz: Toshni sindirganlarida uning tilla bo'laklariga to'la ekanini ko'rishdi.

def: Biror narsa shahar yoki uning hukumatiga aloqador.
ex: Most of the important civic buildings are located downtown.
exuz: Muhim shahar binolarining ko'pchiligi shahar markazida joylashgan.

def: Pastga qarab harakat.
ex: During the space shuttle's descent, the Earth appeared larger and larger.
exuz: Kosmik kema pastga tushayotganda Yer tobora kattaroq ko'rindi.

def: Baland, yoqimsiz va uzoq davom etadigan shovqin.
ex: The din of the rusty machinery made the factory a horrible place to work.
exuz: Zanglagan mashinalarning shovqin-suroni zavodni ishlash uchun dahshatli joyga aylantirgan.

def: Kimnidir xursand qila olmaslik.
ex: He was dissatisfied with his meal.
exuz: U ovqatidan norozi edi.

def: Hech qanday foyda bermaydigan hayajonli yoki jahldor xatti-harakat.
ex: The child made an awful fuss because she didn't want to go to bed.
exuz: Bola uxlagisi kelmagani uchun dahshatli shov-shuv ko'tardi.

def: Go'zallik va hayajonga to'la voqea.
ex: There is nothing glamorous about where we live. It is very ordinary.
exuz: Yashaydigan joyimizda hech qanday jozibadorlik yo'q. U juda oddiy.

def: Ovqat oddiydan yaxshiroq va qimmatroq.
ex: In order to eat a gourmet meal, you have to eat at an expensive restaurant.
exuz: Nafis taom yeyish uchun qimmat restoranga borishingiz kerak.

def: Bu so'z biror narsa boshqa narsaning natijasi ekanini ko'rsatadi.
ex: Mary forgot the key. Hence, we couldn't open the door.
exuz: Meri kalitni unutdi. Shuning uchun biz eshikni och olmadik.

def: Biror narsaning asosiy xususiyatiga aloqador.
ex: Paper money has no intrinsic value. It is useful simply because society says it is.
exuz: Qog'oz pulning o'zida qiymat yo'q. U jamiyat shunday deb aytgani uchungina foydali.

def: Suyuqlik qaynatish yoki ovqat pishirish uchun katta metall qozon.
ex: The soup was being cooked in a large kettle.
exuz: Sho'rva katta qozonda pishirilayotgan edi.

def: Hukumat bo'limi.
ex: The Ministry of Trade is responsible for taxing imports and exports.
exuz: Savdo vazirligi import va eksportga soliq solish uchun mas'ul.

def: Yomon tajriba.
ex: Driving in the snowstorm was an ordeal she'd never forget.
exuz: Qor bo'ronida mashina haydash uning hech qachon unutmaydigan og'ir sinovi edi.

def: Kimdir fikrini aytishdan qo'rqmaydi.
ex: She was an outspoken critic about the new banking laws.
exuz: U yangi bank qonunlarini ochiq-oydin tanqid qiluvchi edi.

def: Kimnidir juda ko'p ish bilan charchatish.
ex: After working for three weeks with only one day of rest, Judy was overworked.
exuz: Faqat bir kun dam olib uch hafta ishlagach, Judi haddan ziyod charchagan edi.

def: Biror narsa guruhning yagona, muhim qismi.
ex: The dress shop didn't have the particular dress she was looking for.
exuz: Ko'ylak do'konida u izlayotgan aynan o'sha ko'ylak yo'q edi.

def: Uxlab yotgan odam har nafas olganda baland tovush chiqarish.
ex: It was impossible to get to sleep because my husband snored.
exuz: Eri xurrak otgani uchun uxlab bo'lmasdi.

def: Biror narsa eng yaxshi yoki eng to'liq usulda qilinadi.
ex: The nearest opponent was ten meters behind. She won the race soundly.
exuz: Eng yaqin raqib o'n metr orqada edi. U poygani ishonchli yutdi.

def: Muayyan bo'lim yoki binoni boshqaradigan odam.
ex: The superintendent decided to close the schools because of the weather.
exuz: Boshliq ob-havo tufayli maktablarni yopishga qaror qildi.

def: Biror narsa to'la yoki to'silgan.
ex: Tom didn't get home until dark because the road was so congested.
exuz: Yo'l juda tirband bo'lgani uchun Tom qorong'i tushguncha uyga yetmadi.

def: Pochta yoki posilkalarni olib boradigan odam.
ex: Before trains, most couriers used horses to travel.
exuz: Poyezdlardan oldin ko'p kuryer otda yurardi.

def: Biror narsani to'g'ri yoki asl shaklidan o'zgartirish.
ex: The computer program deformed the building's picture into an unreal sight.
exuz: Kompyuter dasturi binoning rasmini haqiqiy bo'lmagan ko'rinishga buzib yubordi.

def: Xushmuomala bo'lish haqidagi qoidalar to'plami.
ex: When in Asian countries, bowing is a form of etiquette.
exuz: Osiyo mamlakatlarida ta'zim qilish odob qoidasi hisoblanadi.

def: Biror narsa qimmat va faqat boylar uchun.
ex: The golf course was so exclusive that most people hadn't even heard of it.
exuz: Golf maydoni shunchalik tanlangan ediki, ko'pchilik uning nomini hatto eshitmagan ham edi.

def: Poyezd, kema yoki samolyotda tashiladigan narsalar to'plami.
ex: Trade ships only carried valuable freight like silk and spices.
exuz: Savdo kemalari faqat ipak va ziravorlar kabi qimmatbaho yuk tashirdi.

def: Kiyim bo'lagi.
ex: The businessman had all of his garments cleaned before the important meeting.
exuz: Biznesmen muhim uchrashuvdan oldin barcha kiyimlarini tozalatdi.

def: Odam uxlashda qiynaladigan holat.
ex: Nate's insomnia prevented him from getting enough rest.
exuz: Neytning uyqusizligi unga yetarlicha dam olishga to'sqinlik qildi.

def: Biror narsani dalilsiz sezib bilish.
ex: Rhonda had an intuitive feeling that Shane wasn't coming to school today.
exuz: Ronda Shayn bugun maktabga kelmasligini ichki sezgi bilan his qildi.

def: Biror narsa bo'lishi juda ehtimol.
ex: During the summer months, hikers in the forest are liable to see deer and elk.
exuz: Yoz oylarida o'rmondagi sayyohlar bug'u va to'ng'iz bug'ularni ko'rishi ehtimoli yuqori.

def: Biror narsa haqida doim o'ylayverish.
ex: After watching the Star Wars movies, Ike obsessed about becoming a Jedi.
exuz: «Yulduzlar urushi» filmlarini ko'rgach, Ayk jedi bo'lish haqida o'ylab tinchimay qoldi.

def: Biror narsa kema chetidan oshib suvda.
ex: Tom and Gary slipped on the wet floor and fell overboard.
exuz: Tom va Geri ho'l polda sirpanib, kemadan suvga tushib ketishdi.

def: O'rtachadan yuqori to'lov.
ex: Tony paid a premium for the gas because it made his car run better.
exuz: Toni benzin uchun qo'shimcha to'ladi, chunki u mashinasi yaxshiroq yurishiga sabab bo'ldi.

def: Faqat ma'lum odam yoki guruhga berilgan maxsus huquq.
ex: Only the best employee had the privilege of parking in that spot.
exuz: Faqat eng yaxshi xodimgina o'sha joyga to'xtash imtiyoziga ega edi.

def: Biror narsani biror joyga itarish yoki harakatlantirish.
ex: The strong wind propelled the leaf through the air and across the street.
exuz: Kuchli shamol bargni havoda ko'chaning narigi tomoniga uchirdi.

def: Odamlar bilan yaxshi vaqt o'tkazish.
ex: I like to socialize with my classmates after school.
exuz: Men darsdan keyin sinfdoshlarim bilan muloqot qilishni yoqtiraman.

def: Biror narsaning sodir bo'lishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik.
ex: She suppressed her urge to scream because she didn't want to be noticed.
exuz: U e'tibor tortmaslik uchun qichqirish istagini bosdi.

def: Yer ustidagi elektr bilan yuradigan transport vositasi.
ex: I took the tram to Eighth Avenue.
exuz: Men sakkizinchi xiyobonga tramvayda bordim.

def: Kimnidir xavotirli yoki tashvishli qilish.
ex: The dark clouds in the sky unsettled Beth.
exuz: Osmondagi qora bulutlar Betni bezovta qildi.

def: Noto'g'ri shaklda egilib qolish.
ex: The woman put the clock above the fireplace, and the heat warped it.
exuz: Ayol soatni kamin ustiga qo'ydi va issiqlik uni qiyshaytirdi.

def: Biror narsani vaqt o'tishi bilan ko'p yig'ish.
ex: The mail accumulated in their mailbox while they were on vacation.
exuz: Ular ta'tilda bo'lganda pochta qutisida pochta to'planib qoldi.

def: Biror narsa havoda bo'lish yoki uchishga oid.
ex: The aerial photographer took pictures from the air balloon.
exuz: Havodan suratga oluvchi fotograf havo sharidan surat oldi.

def: Muayyan maqsad uchun ishlatiladigan qurilma.
ex: The campers had an apparatus that showed them their exact location.
exuz: Lagerdagilarda ularning aniq joyini ko'rsatadigan qurilma bor edi.

def: Tog'dan tushadigan katta miqdordagi qor, muz va tosh.
ex: The avalanche destroyed the mountain village.
exuz: Ko'chki tog' qishlog'ini vayron qildi.

def: Doim bir xil xulq qilish holati.
ex: Her consistency in archery meant that our team had a chance to win.
exuz: Uning kamon otishdagi izchilligi jamoamizning yutish imkoniyati borligini bildirardi.

def: Kimgadir biror joydan, odatda kasalxonadan, ketishga ruxsat berish.
ex: I was discharged from the hospital after three days.
exuz: Men uch kundan keyin kasalxonadan chiqarildim.

def: Bir qator voqealarning bir qismi sifatida sodir bo'ladigan narsa.
ex: We watched the final exciting episode of the TV series.
exuz: Biz teleserialning oxirgi hayajonli qismini ko'rdik.

def: Biror narsa to'liq va buzilmagan.
ex: Despite being over 30 years old, my father's model ship is still intact.
exuz: 30 yildan ortiq bo'lsa ham, dadamning model kemasi hamon butun.

def: Odam abadiy yashay olmaydi.
ex: All people are mortal.
exuz: Hamma odam o'ladi.

def: Kelajakda nima bo'lishining belgisi.
ex: He thought that seeing a black cat in the street was an omen of bad luck.
exuz: U ko'chada qora mushukni ko'rish baxtsizlik alomati deb o'yladi.

def: Osmon bulutlarga to'la va quyoshsiz.
ex: The sky was overcast in the morning, but by noon it was bright again.
exuz: Ertalab osmon bulutli edi, lekin tushga borib yana yorishdi.

def: Biror narsa juda kuchli qayg'u hissini uyg'otadi.
ex: The girls cried at the end of the poignant movie.
exuz: Qizlar ta'sirli film oxirida yig'lashdi.

def: O'rmon yoki bog'larni himoya qiladigan odam.
ex: Peter wanted to be a ranger because he liked spending time outside.
exuz: Piter o'rmonchi bo'lishni xohlardi, chunki u tashqarida vaqt o'tkazishni yoqtirardi.

def: Bino buzilgandan keyin qolgan sinik tosh va g'isht uyumi.
ex: There was rubble all over the city after the earthquake.
exuz: Zilziladan keyin butun shahar vayronalarga to'la edi.

def: Kimnidir boshqalardan uzoqda saqlash.
ex: She was secluded on an island for over a year.
exuz: U bir yildan ko'p vaqt orolda yakkalanib yashadi.

def: Biror narsa chetga yoki chetdan harakatlanadi.
ex: Jim turned sideways in order to slow down and stop his snowboard.
exuz: Jim snoubordini sekinlashtirish va to'xtatish uchun yon tomonga burildi.

def: Baland ovozda yig'lash.
ex: I sobbed when my youngest daughter got married.
exuz: Kenja qizim turmushga chiqqanda men hiqillab yig'ladim.

def: Odam yoki narsa jiddiy va xotirjam.
ex: After the funeral, everybody felt very sober.
exuz: Dafndan keyin hamma o'zini juda jiddiy va xotirjam his qildi.

def: Juda kichik belgi yoki miqdor.
ex: A speck of blood appeared where the mosquito had bitten him.
exuz: Chivin chaqqan joyda bir tomchi qon paydo bo'ldi.

def: Kimdir ota-onasi tomonidan o'zini tutishga o'rgatilgan usul.
ex: He had a strict upbringing and was never allowed to watch television.
exuz: U qattiq tarbiya olgan va televizor ko'rishga hech qachon ruxsat berilmagan.

def: To'liq baxt holati.
ex: Every time he sees his girlfriend, he feels a sense of bliss.
exuz: Har safar qiz do'stini ko'rganda u mutlaq baxt tuyg'usini his qiladi.

def: Boy odam uyidagi eng muhim erkak xizmatkor.
ex: Whenever he needed something, he rang a bell, and the butler appeared.
exuz: Biror narsa kerak bo'lganda u qo'ng'iroq chalardi va butler paydo bo'lardi.

def: Jismoniy mashqdan keyin mushakdan paydo bo'ladigan kuchli og'riq.
ex: After the marathon, Jenny got a terrible cramp in her calf muscle.
exuz: Marafondan keyin Jennining boldir mushagi qattiq tortishdi.

def: Xonaga chiroyli narsalar qo'shib, uni jozibador qilish.
ex: Have you decorated the room for Christmas yet?
exuz: Xonani Rojdestvoga bezadingmi?

def: Bino eski va yomon holatda.
ex: Paint peeled off of the old dilapidated apartment building.
exuz: Eski, yaroqsiz holatdagi ko'p qavatli binodan bo'yoq ko'chib tushgan edi.

def: Xotira yoki tuyg'uni paydo qilish.
ex: The picture evoked memories of when she was a young girl.
exuz: Rasm unga yosh qiz bo'lgan paytlarini yodga soldi.

def: Xayrlashish holati yoki usuli.
ex: She got on the plane after we said our farewells.
exuz: Biz xayrlashgach, u samolyotga chiqdi.

def: Suyuqlik yoki gaz oqimini boshqaradigan qurilma.
ex: Turn off the faucet when you are done brushing your teeth.
exuz: Tish yuvib bo'lgach, jo'mrakni yoping.

def: Sizni jirkantiradigan axlat yoki kir.
ex: There was tons of filth and trash on the shore of the river.
exuz: Daryo qirg'og'ida juda ko'p kir va axlat bor edi.

def: Biror narsadagi, uni kamroq samarali yoki noto'g'ri qiladigan xato.
ex: We discovered a major flaw in the metal chain.
exuz: Biz metall zanjirda katta nuqson topdik.

def: Keng jilmayish.
ex: That joke makes me grin every time I hear it.
exuz: Bu hazil har eshitganimda meni tishimni ko'rsatib kuldiradi.

def: Uy yoki mehmonxona kabi joyni saqlash ishlari.
ex: Housekeeping is not much fun, but it has to be done.
exuz: Uy yumushlari unchalik qiziq emas, lekin ularni bajarish kerak.

def: Biror narsaning katta uyumi.
ex: There was a mound of clothes on the teenager's messy floor.
exuz: O'smirning tartibsiz polida kiyimlar uyumi bor edi.

def: Tana qismi hech narsa sezmaydi.
ex: After holding my hand under the icy water, my fingers were numb.
exuz: Qo'limni muzdek suv ostida ushlab turgach, barmoqlarim uvishib qoldi.

def: Odamlar xavfli tarzda harakat qilsa.
ex: The reckless driver posed a threat to everyone else on the road.
exuz: Ehtiyotsiz haydovchi yo'ldagi boshqa hammaga xavf tug'dirdi.

def: Qatlamlarga oson bo'linadigan to'q kulrang tosh.
ex: The roof of the church is made of slate.
exuz: Cherkov tomi shiferdan yasalgan.

def: Oyoqlari bor, lekin suyanchig'i yo'q o'rindiq.
ex: I don't find stools very comfortable to sit on.
exuz: Men taburetkalarda o'tirishni unchalik qulay deb bilmayman.

def: Biror narsa mavjud yoki rost ekanini ko'rsatadigan narsa.
ex: The beautiful performance was a testament to the singer's natural talents.
exuz: Go'zal chiqish qo'shiqchining tabiiy iste'dodiga guvoh edi.

def: Uy qurish va mebel yasash uchun ishlatiladigan yog'och.
ex: Trees in this area are grown specifically to be used for timber.
exuz: Bu hududdagi daraxtlar aynan qurilish yog'ochi sifatida ishlatish uchun o'stiriladi.

def: Quvurga o'rnatilgan, suyuqlik yoki havo oqimini boshqaradigan qurilma.
ex: The mechanic removed the dirt to clear the engine valve.
exuz: Usta dvigatel klapanini tozalash uchun kirni olib tashladi.

def: Odam va narsalarni yashirish uchun ishlatiladigan narsa.
ex: The green and brown camouflage was best used for hiding in forests and jungles.
exuz: Yashil va jigarrang kamuflyaj o'rmon va changalzorda yashirinish uchun eng yaxshi edi.

def: Muammoni hal qilish uchun kimdir bilan yuzma-yuz uchrashish.
ex: I confronted him as he left the meeting and told him I thought he was wrong.
exuz: Men u uchrashuvdan chiqayotganda u bilan yuzma-yuz gaplashib, xato deb o'ylashimni aytdim.

def: Biror narsa haqida o'ylash.
ex: Mark took a moment to contemplate the math problem before solving it.
exuz: Mark matematika masalasini yechishdan oldin bir zum chuqur o'yladi.

def: Biror narsani yengib o'tish uchun kurashish.
ex: Stacy had to contend with a learning disability throughout high school.
exuz: Steysi butun o'rta maktab davomida o'qish qiyinchiligi bilan kurashishi kerak edi.

def: Kichik ko'chma karavot.
ex: At the camp, the boys' cabin was lined with cots.
exuz: Lagerda o'g'il bolalar kulbasi yig'ma karavotlar bilan to'la edi.

def: Armiyaga qo'shilish.
ex: In their final year at school, the students were asked to enlist in the military.
exuz: Maktabning oxirgi yilida o'quvchilardan armiyaga yozilish so'raldi.

def: Ikki hudud yoki mamlakat orasidagi chegara.
ex: A fence was built along the frontier where the river curved.
exuz: Daryo egrilgan joydagi chegara bo'ylab to'siq qurildi.

def: Norasmiy qo'shin tarkibida kurashadigan odam.
ex: Guerrilla warfare involves a lot of hit-and-run fighting.
exuz: Partizan urushida ko'p marta hujum qilib qochish jangi bo'ladi.

def: Muayyan ma'lumot yoki ko'rsatmalar beradigan material.
ex: If you look at the handbook, it will tell you which wires to connect to the TV.
exuz: Qo'llanmaga qarasangiz, u sizga televizorga qaysi simlarni ulashni aytadi.

def: Kimdir ishonchsiz yoki harakatda yoki gapirishda sekin.
ex: Although he knew the answer, he was hesitant to say it because he might be wrong.
exuz: U javobni bilsa-da, noto'g'ri bo'lishi mumkinligi uchun aytishga ikkilanardi.

def: Joy ko'p turdagi katta, sog'lom o'simliklarga to'la.
ex: The lush jungle was filled with plants, trees, and vines.
exuz: Yam-yashil changalzor o'simlik, daraxt va chirmashgan toklar bilan to'la edi.

def: Odatda ma'lum ish yoki tadbir uchun birga kiyiladigan kiyimlar.
ex: Kelly's new outfit made her look so glamorous.
exuz: Kellining yangi kiyimi uni juda jozibali ko'rsatdi.

def: Hayvonning tirnoqli yoki yumshoq oyoq panjasi.
ex: The kitten cleaned its paws with its tongue.
exuz: Mushukcha panjalarini tili bilan tozaladi.

def: Kimdir yoki nimadir juda yaxshi.
ex: From his head down to his shoes, his clothes looked splendid.
