exuz: Boshidan to poyabzaligacha uning kiyimlari ajoyib ko'rinardi.

def: Noto'g'ri yo'nalishga ketib, yo'qolish.
ex: He found himself lost because he had strayed from the tour group.
exuz: U sayohat guruhidan adashib, yo'qolib qolganini angladi.

def: Biror narsa katta ahamiyat, o'lcham yoki qiymatga ega.
ex: The bank said that he owed it a substantial amount of money.
exuz: Bank uning oldida katta miqdorda qarzi borligini aytdi.

def: Bir uchi yonadigan, yorug'lik berish uchun ko'tariladigan tayoq.
ex: He grabbed a piece of wood and stuck it in the fire in order to make a torch.
exuz: U mash'ala yasash uchun bir bo'lak yog'ochni olib, olovga tiqdi.

def: Katta yer bo'lagi.
ex: On the other side of the mountains, there was a long tract of forest.
exuz: Tog'larning narigi tomonida uzun o'rmon maydoni bor edi.

def: Aniq maqsadda tunda ehtiyotkorlik bilan kuzatish davri.
ex: He had a vigil in front of the tomb for three days.
exuz: U uch kun maqbara oldida navbatchilik qildi.

def: Kimdir charchagan.
ex: Jane was weary after a long day of work.
exuz: Jeyn uzun ish kunidan keyin charchagan edi.

def: Biror narsa boshqasining o'rtasida.
ex: The bee was busily flying amid the flowers in the garden.
exuz: Ari bog'dagi gullar orasida band bo'lib uchib yurardi.

def: Biror narsa teatr sahnasi orqasida sodir bo'ladi.
ex: After the show, the director went backstage and thanked the actors.
exuz: Shoudan keyin rejissyor sahna orqasiga borib, aktyorlarga rahmat aytdi.

def: Kamida bir milliard dollari bor odam.
ex: The sale of his inventions made the inventor a billionaire.
exuz: Ixtirolarining sotilishi ixtirochini milliarderga aylantirdi.

def: Zo'ravon hayvonday o'zini tutadigan yoki shunday ko'rinadigan odam.
ex: My older brother can act like a brute when he doesn't get his way.
exuz: Katta akam o'zi xohlaganini qilolmasa, yirtqichdek o'zini tutishi mumkin.

def: Kimdir narsalarni ushlashda noqulay.
ex: The businessman was clumsy and dropped his work files.
exuz: Biznesmen qo'pol edi va ish hujjatlarini tushirib yubordi.

def: Harakatlanayotganda biror narsaga urilish.
ex: The two cars collided with each other because their drivers were not careful.
exuz: Ikki mashina bir-biriga to'qnashdi, chunki haydovchilari ehtiyotsiz edi.

def: Jinoyat yoki yomon ish qilgan odam.
ex: The police were still searching for the culprit from the robbery.
exuz: Politsiya hali ham talonchilikdagi aybdorni qidirmoqda edi.

def: Xavfli joydan xavfsiz joyga ko'chirish.
ex: During the flood, many families were evacuated to higher ground.
exuz: Toshqin paytida ko'p oila balandroq joyga evakuatsiya qilindi.

def: Biror narsa olov olishi mumkin.
ex: Be careful with that blanket near the candle. It is extremely flammable.
exuz: Shamning yonidagi o'sha adyoldan ehtiyot bo'ling. U juda yonuvchan.

def: Ko'pincha zo'ravonlik qilishni istaydigan katta olomon.
ex: The copier was destroyed by a mob of angry workers.
exuz: Nusxa ko'chirish mashinasi g'azablangan ishchilar olomoni tomonidan buzildi.

def: Biror narsa juda erta yoki o'z vaqtidan oldin qilinadi.
ex: Mark's celebration was premature because the ball hadn't fallen in the hole.
exuz: Markning bayrami erta edi, chunki to'p hali teshikka tushmagan edi.

def: Biror narsadan yomon his-tuyg'uda bo'lish.
ex: He resented the fact that he had never been able to play an instrument.
exuz: U hech qachon cholg'u chala olmaganidan ranjirdi.

def: Hazil va kinoya yordamida biror narsani masxara qiluvchi san'at asari.
ex: This book is a satire of what life was like in the army.
exuz: Bu kitob armiyadagi hayotni masxara qiluvchi satira.

def: Biror narsani diqqat bilan o'rganish.
ex: A scientist should always practice scrutiny with their work.
exuz: Olim ishida doim sinchkovlik bilan tekshirishi kerak.

def: Biror narsani boshqalardan alohida guruhga qo'yish.
ex: In gym class, the children were segregated into two groups: boys and girls.
exuz: Jismoniy tarbiya darsida bolalar ikki guruhga — o'g'il va qizlarga — ajratildi.

def: Kimnidir biror ishni qilishga yoki boshdan kechirishga majburlash.
ex: The officers subjected everyone to a careful search before they left the plane.
exuz: Ofitserlar samolyotdan chiqishdan oldin hammani sinchkovlik bilan tintuv qildi.

def: Guvoh sifatida dalil keltirish.
ex: The judge listened while the victim testified about the robbery.
exuz: Sudya jabrlanuvchi talonchilik haqida guvohlik berayotganini tingladi.

def: Katta olomon chiqargan baland va chalkash shovqin.
ex: She couldn't hear her friend over the tumult of the other excited guests.
exuz: U boshqa hayajonlangan mehmonlarning g'ala-g'ovuri ichida do'stini eshita olmadi.

def: Biror narsa yoki kimnidir aslidan kamroq deb o'ylash.
ex: We lost the game because we underestimated the other team's skill.
exuz: Biz o'yinda yutqazdik, chunki boshqa jamoaning mahoratini kam baholadik.

def: Juda jahldor yoki xafa odamlar chiqargan baland shovqin.
ex: The fans made a great uproar when their team lost the game.
exuz: Jamoasi o'yinda yutqazganda muxlislar katta shov-shuv ko'tarishdi.

def: Tezlikni oshirish.
ex: When he stepped on the gas pedal, the motorcycle accelerated.
exuz: U gaz pedaliga bosganda mototsikl tezlashdi.

def: Biror ishni yana, ehtimol boshqacha tarzda, qilish.
ex: Although he had failed his driving test, he decided to try it anew.
exuz: Haydovchilik imtihonidan yiqilgan bo'lsa-da, u uni yana qaytadan urinib ko'rishga qaror qildi.

def: Biror narsaning noto'g'ri yoki yetishmayotgan qismi.
ex: All these bottles have a defect and must be sent back to the warehouse.
exuz: Bu shishalarning hammasida nuqson bor va ularni omborga qaytarish kerak.

def: Biror narsa zerikarli, qorong'i va jonsiz.
ex: After the fire, this section of forest is rather dreary.
exuz: Yong'indan keyin o'rmonning bu qismi ancha g'amgin ko'rinadi.

def: Biror narsaning nusxasini yasash.
ex: She duplicated her friend's movements like she was in front of a mirror.
exuz: U do'stining harakatlarini xuddi ko'zgu oldida turgandek takrorladi.

def: Biror narsa elektr va magnit maydonlariga oid.
ex: Different colors of light come from different levels of electromagnetic energy.
exuz: Yorug'likning turli ranglari elektromagnit energiyaning turli darajalaridan keladi.

def: Barcha atomlardagi manfiy elektr zaryadli zarra.
ex: The number of electrons in an atom determines its charge.
exuz: Atomdagi elektronlar soni uning zaryadini belgilaydi.

def: Uzun qanotlarda kam kuch bilan uchish.
ex: When the wind is blowing, birds can glide easily through the sky.
exuz: Shamol esganda qushlar osmonda osongina sirpanib uchishi mumkin.

def: Kimdir juda aqlli.
ex: Charles was the only person ingenious enough to repair the plane's engines.
exuz: Charlz samolyot dvigatellarini tuzatadigan darajada zukko yagona odam edi.

def: Yangi yoki original mahsulot yoki g'oya.
ex: Mrs. Johnson made a great innovation to the company's business plan.
exuz: Jonson xonim kompaniyaning biznes rejasiga katta yangilik kiritdi.

def: Kimdir ijodiy fikrlay oladi.
ex: Since Peter was so innovative, he was chosen to lead the science team.
exuz: Piter juda yangilikka intiluvchan bo'lgani uchun u fan jamoasiga rahbar etib tanlandi.

def: Biror narsani harakatga keltirish.
ex: The boat launched from the dock and floated down the river.
exuz: Qayiq dokdan suvga tushib, daryo bo'ylab suzib ketdi.

def: Biror narsa ob-havo ilmiga oid.
ex: The thunderstorm was so large that it became a great meteorological event.
exuz: Momaqaldiroqli bo'ron shu qadar katta ediki, u buyuk meteorologik voqeaga aylandi.

def: Ob-havoni o'rganadigan fan.
ex: In order to understand the weather better, you should study meteorology.
exuz: Ob-havoni yaxshiroq tushunish uchun meteorologiyani o'rganishingiz kerak.

def: Biror narsaning ichiga kirish.
ex: The knife easily penetrated the surface of the orange.
exuz: Pichoq apelsin yuzasini osongina teshib kirdi.

def: Kimdir taslim bo'lmay ishlayveradi.
ex: They made persistent attempts to get him to eat.
exuz: Ular uni ovqat yeyishga undash uchun tinimsiz urinishdi.

def: Biror narsani oldinga harakatlantiradigan kuch.
ex: The propulsion lifted the rocket into the sky.
exuz: Itarish kuchi raketani osmonga ko'tardi.

def: Biror narsaning harakatlari yoki xususiyatlarini nusxalash.
ex: The French language teacher could simulate the accent of a French citizen.
exuz: Fransuz tili ustozi fransuz fuqarosining talaffuzini taqlid qila olardi.

def: Kimnidir harakatga undash.
ex: The coach's speech spurred her team into playing the best game of their lives.
exuz: Murabbiyning nutqi uning jamoasini hayotidagi eng yaxshi o'yinni o'ynashga undadi.

def: Faoliyatni keltirib chiqarish yoki oshirish.
ex: Doctors sometimes use electric shock to stimulate a patient's heartbeat.
exuz: Shifokorlar ba'zan bemorning yurak urishini rag'batlantirish uchun elektr zarbasidan foydalanadi.

def: Biror ish oldindan qilinadi.
ex: He packed his luggage beforehand, so he was able to leave right away.
exuz: U yukini oldindan joyladi, shuning uchun darhol jo'nab keta oldi.

def: Biror narsa aniq ko'rinmaydi.
ex: There were blurred photographs of what was supposed to be a flying saucer.
exuz: Uchar likopcha bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan narsaning xira suratlari bor edi.

def: Harorat Selsiy bilan bir xil ko'rsatilsa.
ex: During the spring time, the temperature gets as warm as 26 degrees centigrade.
exuz: Bahor paytida harorat 26 daraja Selsiygacha iliydi.

def: Ahamiyatsiz narsalar haqida tez gapirish.
ex: The children chattered in the back of the classroom.
exuz: Bolalar sinfning orqasida valaqlashdi.

def: Orkestr bilan chalinadigan, yakka cholg'u ajralib turadigan musiqa.
ex: The piano concerto has a section in which only the piano plays.
exuz: Pianino kontsertining faqat pianino chaladigan qismi bor.

def: Gazni suyuqlikka aylantirish.
ex: The cool air made tiny drops of water condense on the tops of the grass.
exuz: Salqin havo o't uchlarida mayda suv tomchilarini hosil qildi.

def: Asta-sekin battarroq bo'lib borish.
ex: The nation's economy continued to deteriorate despite the politicians' efforts.
exuz: Siyosatchilarning harakatlariga qaramay, mamlakat iqtisodiyoti yomonlashishda davom etdi.

def: Haroratni o'lchash birligi.
ex: The thermometer recorded a temperature of 38 degrees Celsius.
exuz: Termometr 38 daraja Selsiy haroratni qayd etdi.

def: Biror narsaning tashqi yuzasi.
ex: The exterior of the nut was hard and woody, but the inside was soft and delicious.
exuz: Yong'oqning tashqi qismi qattiq va yog'ochsimon edi, lekin ichi yumshoq va mazali edi.

def: Kimdir yoki nimadir baland va xursand.
ex: The grandmother ended her story with a hearty laugh that pleased her grandchild.
exuz: Buvi hikoyasini nevarasini xursand qilgan samimiy kulgi bilan tugatdi.

def: Kimdir begonalar bilan do'stona munosabatda.
ex: At dinner, my dad was very hospitable to my friends.
exuz: Kechki ovqatda dadam do'stlarimga juda mehmondo'st bo'ldi.

def: Sizni kuldiradigan narsa yoki his-tuyg'ularingiz.
ex: He woke up in an ill humor, angry at everyone.
exuz: U yomon kayfiyatda uyg'ondi va hammaga jahli chiqdi.

def: Ko'p xonali katta uy.
ex: The manor had over forty rooms and beautiful gardens.
exuz: Saroyda qirqtadan ortiq xona va go'zal bog'lar bor edi.

def: Rohiblar yashaydigan bino.
ex: The monks at this monastery are famous for their bread and music.
exuz: Bu monastirdagi rohiblar noni va musiqasi bilan mashhur.

def: Chaqaloq va bolalar uxlaydigan, o'ynaydigan yoki qaraladigan xona.
ex: The children kissed their parents goodnight and went upstairs to the nursery.
exuz: Bolalar ota-onasini xayrli tun deb o'pib, yuqoridagi bolalar xonasiga chiqishdi.

def: Biror narsa to'liq uzunligiga cho'zilgan.
ex: The cat stood on its back legs with its front legs outstretched.
exuz: Mushuk orqa oyoqlarida turib, old oyoqlarini cho'zdi.

def: Biror joyga olib borish yoki pochta bilan yuboriladigan narsalar o'rami.
ex: The parcel looked like it had been stepped on by someone.
exuz: Posilka kimdir bosib o'tgandek ko'rinardi.

def: Yuzning, odatda yon tomondan ko'rinadigan, konturi.
ex: The drawing of Olivia's profile came out very well.
exuz: Oliviyaning profil rasmi juda yaxshi chiqdi.

def: Biror narsa buralib boradigan yo'ldan boradi.
ex: The winding river turned and looped around the hills.
exuz: Egri-bugri daryo burilib, tepaliklarni aylanib o'tdi.

def: Biror narsani zanjir bilan yopish.
ex: She zipped her backpack closed after putting her books inside it.
exuz: U kitoblarini solgach, ryukzagining zanjirini tortib yopdi.

def: Biror narsaga, masalan, tizim yoki qonunga, nuqta qo'yish.
ex: President Lincoln abolished slavery in the US.
exuz: Prezident Linkoln AQShda qullikni bekor qildi.

def: Biror narsani yaxshilash yoki aniqroq qilish uchun o'zgartirish.
ex: The countries were in agreement that the treaty needed to be amended.
exuz: Mamlakatlar shartnomani o'zgartirish kerakligi haqida kelishdi.

def: Biror narsaga erishish yoki qilishga kuchli istak bo'lish.
ex: George aspired to be a doctor from a young age.
exuz: Jorj yoshligidan shifokor bo'lishni orzu qilardi.

def: Xavfli, qo'pol yoki isyonkor bo'lsa, biror narsani olib tashlash.
ex: To protect innocent people, the location of the bomb was censored.
exuz: Begunoh odamlarni himoya qilish uchun bomba joylashuvi yashirildi.

def: Tashkilot yoki guruh huquqlarini tasvirlaydigan hujjat.
ex: The company charter explained that all employees had to pay a tax.
exuz: Kompaniya nizomida barcha xodimlar soliq to'lashi kerakligi tushuntirilgan edi.

def: Hukumat uchun tamoyillar hujjati.
ex: The country's constitution said a prime minister could only serve three terms.
exuz: Mamlakat konstitutsiyasiga ko'ra, bosh vazir faqat uch muddat xizmat qilishi mumkin edi.

def: Joy turli joylardan kelgan odamlarga to'la.
ex: There are dozens of different types of restaurants in a cosmopolitan city.
exuz: Kosmopolit shaharda o'nlab turli xil restoranlar bor.

def: Ma'lumot yoki bilimni tarqatish.
ex: The organization disseminates information about the dangers of smoking.
exuz: Tashkilot chekishning xavfi haqida ma'lumot tarqatadi.

def: Odamlarni xursand qilish uchun maqtash.
ex: He was just flattering me when he said that my new dress looked gorgeous.
exuz: U yangi ko'ylagim ajoyib ko'rinadi deganda faqat menga xushomad qilayotgan edi.

def: Kimdir biror yomon ish bilan yaxshi tanilgan.
ex: That news channel is infamous for presenting biased information.
exuz: O'sha yangiliklar kanali xolis bo'lmagan ma'lumot berishi bilan badnom.

def: Oyoq yoki panja jarohati tufayli yaxshi yura olmaydigan.
ex: The terrible accident left many people dead and several others lame.
exuz: Dahshatli hodisa ko'p odamning o'limiga va bir necha kishining cho'loq bo'lib qolishiga olib keldi.

def: Oyog'i og'rigani uchun qiynalib yurish.
ex: After the injury, the player limped off of the field.
exuz: Jarohatdan keyin o'yinchi maydondan oqsoqlanib chiqib ketdi.

def: Hissiyotning to'satdan kuchli namoyon bo'lishi.
ex: There was an outburst of cheers when the comedian took the stage.
exuz: Komik sahnaga chiqqanda baland olqishlar yangradi.

def: Xulq haddan tashqari, qabul qilib bo'lmaydigan va ba'zan kasallik belgisi.
ex: The pathological liar could not even tell the truth about unimportant matters.
exuz: Kasalcha yolg'onchi hatto ahamiyatsiz masalalarda ham rost gapira olmasdi.

def: Biror narsa g'ayrioddiy darajada yaxshi.
ex: The child's ability to play the piano is nothing short of phenomenal.
exuz: Bolaning pianino chalish qobiliyati bo'lsa ajoyibdan kam emas.

def: Odamlar muhim narsalar haqida fikr bildiradigan so'rov.
ex: The poll showed that many people support the plan to stop gang violence.
exuz: So'rovnoma ko'p odam to'dalar zo'ravonligini to'xtatish rejasini qo'llab-quvvatlashini ko'rsatdi.

def: Qattiq qayg'u va afsuslanish hissi.
ex: When I realized what I had done, I felt remorse for my actions.
exuz: Nima qilganimni anglaganimda, qilmishimdan pushaymon bo'ldim.

def: Biror narsani sir tutish xatti-harakati.
ex: The secrecy of the big organization made the government nervous.
exuz: Katta tashkilotning sir saqlashi hukumatni xavotirga soldi.

def: Biror narsani qat'iy va samarali hal qilish.
ex: Such social problems need to be tackled right away.
exuz: Bunday ijtimoiy muammolarni zudlik bilan hal qilish kerak.

def: Odamlar uxlab qolgandek va o'zini boshqara olmaydigan holat.
ex: The woman's powerful eyes often put men in a trance.
exuz: Ayolning kuchli ko'zlari erkaklarni ko'pincha transga soldi.

def: Xavfli ishlarni qilishga jasorati yetmaydigan odam.
ex: A firefighter cannot be a coward. They have to be able to act quickly.
exuz: O't o'chiruvchi qo'rqoq bo'la olmaydi. U tez harakat qila olishi kerak.

def: Yozilgan narsani olib tashlash yoki o'chirish.
ex: Several lines had been deleted from her speech.
exuz: Uning nutqidan bir necha qator o'chirilgan edi.

def: Kimdir halol.
ex: The child was very earnest when he told his mother how he broke the dish.
exuz: Bola onasiga idishni qanday sindirganini aytganda juda samimiy edi.

def: Biror narsa o'xshash madaniyatli guruhga aloqador.
ex: Many sections of the city are home to different ethnic communities.
exuz: Shaharning ko'p qismida turli etnik jamoalar yashaydi.

def: Kimnidir guruhga qabul qilmaslik.
ex: Carol was excluded from the contest because her friend was a judge.
exuz: Karol musobaqadan chetlatildi, chunki uning do'sti hakam edi.

def: Biror narsa asl manbadan.
ex: If you want firsthand knowledge, ask someone who saw it.
exuz: Bevosita bilim olmoqchi bo'lsangiz, uni ko'rgan odamdan so'rang.

def: Kimdir tilni juda yaxshi gapira oladi.
ex: She was so fluent in German that you'd have thought she was from Germany.
exuz: U nemis tilida shunchalik ravon ediki, uni Germaniyadan deb o'ylash mumkin edi.

def: Biror narsa imperiyaga aloqador.
ex: These old imperial coins were once used in the Roman Empire.
exuz: Bu eski imperiya tangalari bir vaqtlar Rim imperiyasida ishlatilgan.

def: Biror narsa jamiyatdagi barcha guruh va odamlarga ochiq.
ex: A more inclusive event would have allowed children to attend.
exuz: Hammani qamrab oluvchi tadbir bolalarga ham qatnashishga ruxsat bergan bo'lardi.

def: Hukumatning qonun chiqaradigan qismi.
ex: The senator had served ten years in the national legislature.
exuz: Senator o'n yil milliy qonun chiqaruvchi organda xizmat qilgan edi.

def: Biror narsa tilga aloqador.
ex: A linguistic way of studying culture focuses on words within that culture.
exuz: Madaniyatni o'rganishning tilshunoslik usuli shu madaniyatdagi so'zlarga e'tibor qaratadi.

def: Kimdir faqat bitta tilda gapiradi.
ex: In today's global economy, being monolingual limits your opportunities.
exuz: Bugungi global iqtisodiyotda bir tilli bo'lish imkoniyatlaringizni cheklaydi.

def: Qaysi davlatdan kelganingizga asoslangan shaxsiyat.
ex: His nationality is German, but he speaks French, Spanish, and Korean.
exuz: Uning millati nemis, lekin u fransuz, ispan va koreys tillarida gapiradi.

def: O'z yurtini sevadigan, qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan va himoya qiladigan odam.
ex: Every year, young patriots join their countries' militaries.
exuz: Har yili yosh vatanparvarlar o'z mamlakatlari armiyasiga qo'shiladi.

def: Kimgadir qarshi qonuniy chora ko'rish.
ex: They were prosecuted for fishing in the river without a permit.
exuz: Ular daryoda ruxsatsiz baliq ovlagani uchun sudga tortildi.

def: Biror narsa irq yoki irqlarga aloqador.
ex: The differences between racial groups are physical characteristics and culture.
exuz: Irqiy guruhlar orasidagi farqlar jismoniy xususiyatlar va madaniyatdan iborat.

def: Biror narsa jiddiy va halol.
ex: The professor preferred a solemn relationship between him and his students.
exuz: Professor o'zi va talabalari orasida jiddiy munosabatni afzal ko'rardi.

def: Umumiy mas'uliyat yoki manfaatlardan hosil bo'lgan birlik.
ex: All the citizens came together in a show of solidarity to create change.
exuz: Barcha fuqarolar o'zgarish yaratish uchun hamjihatlik ko'rsatib birlashdi.

def: Muammolarga duch kelganda odamlarni xafa qilmaslik qobiliyati.
ex: Since both sides would not agree, it required someone with tact to make peace.
exuz: Ikkala tomon ham kelishmagani uchun yarashtirish uchun nozik didli odam kerak edi.

def: Kimnidir xiyonat qilish yoki uning urinishi yoki vakolatini susaytirish.
ex: The documents helped to undermine the workers' trust in their bosses' honesty.
exuz: Hujjatlar ishchilarning boshliqlari halolligiga bo'lgan ishonchini susaytirishga yordam berdi.

def: Biror narsaning rivojlanishini cheklash.
ex: Jim cannot join us because he is constrained by previous plans.
exuz: Jim bizga qo'shila olmaydi, chunki u oldingi rejalari bilan cheklangan.

def: Avtobus yoki poyezd bekati.
ex: He waited for his mother to arrive at the depot.
exuz: U onasi bekatga yetib kelishini kutdi.

def: Qattiq qoyil qolgani uchun odamlarga taqlid qilish.
ex: As a small boy, he always tried to emulate his big brother.
exuz: Kichkina bola paytida u doim katta akasiga taqlid qilishga urinardi.

def: Bosh barmoq va o'rta barmoq orasidagi barmoq.
ex: He shouted, "There it is!" and pointed with his forefinger.
exuz: U «Mana u!» deb baqirib, ko'rsatkich barmog'i bilan ishora qildi.

def: Odam yoki hayvon ichidagi barcha a'zolar.
ex: The doctor can tell you every process that happens in one's guts.
exuz: Shifokor odamning ichki a'zolarida bo'ladigan har bir jarayonni aytib bera oladi.

def: Biror narsa boshqa narsaning tabiiy qismi.
ex: Sweating is an inherent bodily function when exercising.
exuz: Mashq qilganda terlash tananing tabiiy vazifasi.

def: Boshqalarni cho'chitish.
ex: My dad intimidates my friends whenever they visit.
exuz: Do'stlarim kelganda dadam ularni qo'rqitadi.

def: Binoni tuzatadigan va unga qaraydigan odam.
ex: The school janitor cleaned up the messy cafeteria.
exuz: Maktab farroshi tartibsiz oshxonani tozaladi.

def: Biror narsa ozgina ho'l.
ex: The ground is still moist from the rain last night.
exuz: Kechagi yomg'irdan yer hali ham nam.

def: «Yo'q» deyishning norasmiy usuli.
ex: He asked if I had any money, and I had to say, "Nope."
exuz: U menda pul bormi deb so'radi va men «Yo'q» deyishimga to'g'ri keldi.

def: Kimnidir barmoq yoki uchli narsa bilan itarish.
ex: The bully prodded me in the chest with her finger.
exuz: Zo'ravon qiz barmog'i bilan ko'kragimga turtdi.

def: O'g'irlab ketilgan odamni ozod qilish uchun to'lanadigan pul miqdori.
ex: He kidnapped the prince and demanded $1 million as a ransom.
exuz: U shahzodani o'g'irlab, to'lov sifatida bir million dollar talab qildi.

def: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir to'xtatish uchun jismoniy kuch ishlatish.
ex: Mike restrained Allen from reaching the door.
exuz: Mayk Allenni eshikka yetishidan ushlab qoldi.

def: Odamlar og'zidagi hazm qilishga yordam beradigan suvli suyuqlik.
ex: The baby could not keep the saliva from dripping out of its mouth.
exuz: Chaqaloq so'lagi og'zidan oqishini to'xtata olmasdi.

def: Og'izdan suyuqlikni kuch bilan chiqarish.
ex: He emerged from the pool and spit water from his mouth.
exuz: U basseyndan chiqib, og'zidagi suvni tupurdi.

def: Qisqa masofada juda tez yugurish.
ex: The kids didn't want to be late to class, so they sprinted to the bus stop.
exuz: Bolalar darsga kech qolishni xohlamadi, shuning uchun avtobus bekatiga chopib borishdi.

def: Diqqat jalb qilish uchun qilinadigan ish.
ex: The man jumped over the cars as a promotional stunt.
exuz: Erkak reklama maqsadida mashinalar ustidan sakrab o'tdi.

def: Odamlar boshqalarning huquq va e'tiqodlarini hurmat qilsa.
ex: The tolerant leader thought that everyone was equal regardless of race.
exuz: Bag'rikeng rahbar irqidan qat'i nazar hamma teng deb o'ylardi.

def: Tobutda uxlab, odamlar qonini so'radigan xayoliy maxluq.
ex: The vampire snuck up on the woman and bit her neck.
exuz: Vampir ayolning ortidan yashirincha kelib, bo'yniga tishladi.

def: Og'zini katta ochib, havo olish.
ex: The child yawned and stretched her arms before going to bed for the night.
exuz: Bola tunga uxlashga yotishdan oldin esnab, qo'llarini cho'zdi.

def: Biror narsa binoga yoki xonaga yonma-yon yoki ulangan.
ex: I couldn't sleep because the people in the adjoining room were loud.
exuz: Men uxlay olmadim, chunki qo'shni xonadagi odamlar baland ovozda edi.

def: Biror narsa rost deb dalilsiz aytish.
ex: The little girl had alleged that her older brother hid her favorite doll.
exuz: Kichkina qiz akasi sevimli qo'g'irchog'ini yashirgan deb da'vo qilgan edi.

def: Ko'prik yoki eshik kabi inshoot ostida hosil bo'lgan egri teshik.
ex: The arch of the bridge was not high enough for the tall boat to pass underneath.
exuz: Ko'prik ravog'i baland qayiq ostidan o'tishi uchun yetarlicha baland emas edi.

def: Bir joyda birga bo'lish.
ex: The parents assembled to discuss ways to improve their children's education.
exuz: Ota-onalar farzandlari ta'limini yaxshilash yo'llarini muhokama qilish uchun yig'ilishdi.

def: Urush yoki baxtsiz hodisada halok bo'lgan yoki jarohatlangan odam.
ex: The only casualty in the car accident was a woman who broke her arm.
exuz: Avtohalokatdagi yagona jabrlanuvchi qo'li singan ayol edi.

def: Biror narsani qurish.
ex: The king erected two towers on the north and south sides of his castle.
exuz: Shoh qal'asining shimol va janub tomonlarida ikkita minora qurdi.

def: Biror narsa juda yoqimsiz.
ex: He wouldn't let his dog drink from the water because it had a foul smell.
exuz: U itining suvdan ichishiga yo'l qo'ymadi, chunki unda jirkanch hid bor edi.

def: 10 000 kvadrat metrga teng o'lchov birligi.
ex: His family farm covered many hectares.
exuz: Uning oilaviy fermasi ko'p gektarni egallardi.

def: Hissiyot kuchini oshirish.
ex: The pleasant music heightened their enjoyment of the wonderful dinner.
exuz: Yoqimli musiqa ularning ajoyib kechki ovqatdan zavqini oshirdi.

def: Mehmon yoki begonalarga ko'rsatiladigan do'stona munosabat va xizmat.
ex: The travelers were amazed at the hospitality given them by the hotel's staff.
exuz: Sayohatchilar mehmonxona xodimlarining mehmondo'stligidan hayratda qolishdi.

def: Katta va qimmat uy.
ex: The mansion had thirty bedrooms, two kitchens, and a pool.
exuz: Saroyda o'ttizta yotoqxona, ikkita oshxona va basseyn bor edi.

def: Guruhning soni ko'proq bo'lishi.
ex: The girls outnumbered the boys at the school by four to one.
exuz: Maktabda qizlar o'g'il bolalardan to'rt barobar ko'p edi.

def: Kimdir juda xursand.
ex: He was overjoyed by the news of his promotion.
exuz: U lavozimi oshgani haqidagi xabardan behad xursand bo'ldi.

def: Hayvonlar ovqat sifatida ishlatadigan o'tli yer maydoni.
ex: The sheep were taken to a pasture where there was more grass.
exuz: Qo'ylar o'ti ko'proq bo'lgan yaylovga olib ketildi.

def: Hokimiyatdan biror ish qilishni so'rovchi yozma talab.
ex: The citizens all signed a petition asking the mayor to repair the sidewalks.
exuz: Fuqarolarning hammasi hokimdan yo'laklarni ta'mirlashni so'raydigan iltimosnomaga imzo chekdi.

def: Binoni tuzatish yoki unga yangi inshootlar qurish.
ex: The old fire station was renovated into an apartment building.
exuz: Eski o't o'chirish bekati ko'p qavatli turar-joy binosiga aylantirildi.

def: Biror narsani yaxshiroq qilish uchun o'zgartirish yoki yangilash.
ex: When the editor discovered certain facts were wrong, he revised the book.
exuz: Muharrir ba'zi faktlar noto'g'ri ekanini aniqlagach, kitobni qayta ko'rib chiqdi.

def: Tosh, beton, metall yoki yog'ochdan qilingan katta, qalin, yassi bo'lak.
ex: I looked at various slabs of stone to decorate my house.
exuz: Uyimni bezash uchun turli tosh plitalarni ko'rib chiqdim.

def: Uy yoki kvartiraga ulangan ochiq joy.
ex: In the afternoons, she liked to sit on the terrace and check her email.
exuz: Tushdan keyin u ayvonda o'tirib, elektron pochtasini tekshirishni yoqtirardi.

def: O'tning o'sadigan va tuproq bilan birga bo'lgan bo'lagi.
ex: After the game, the turf looked ragged.
exuz: O'yindan keyin maysazor ayanchli ko'rinardi.

def: Biror narsa boshqasiga ba'zi jihatdan o'xshaydi.
ex: The relationship with his teacher was analogous to that of a son and mother.
exuz: Uning ustozi bilan munosabati o'g'il va ona munosabatiga o'xshardi.

def: Uzoqdagi narsalarni ko'rish uchun ishlatiladigan qurilma.
ex: He could see the ship on the horizon only if he used his binoculars.
exuz: U ufqdagi kemani faqat durbin ishlatsagina ko'ra olardi.

def: Biror narsaning katta o'lchami.
ex: The large elephant moved its bulk with legs as strong as tree trunks.
exuz: Katta fil o'zining ulkan tanasini daraxt tanasidek baquvvat oyoqlarida ko'tarib yurdi.

def: Biror narsa boshqa narsadan iborat bo'lsa.
ex: Our school's football team is mostly comprised of seniors.
exuz: Maktabimiz futbol jamoasi asosan katta sinf o'quvchilaridan iborat.

def: Biror narsani, ko'pincha san'at yordamida, ko'rsatish.
ex: The statue's face depicted the general's determination and courage.
exuz: Haykal yuzi generalning qat'iyati va jasoratini tasvirlagan.

def: Biror narsa ikki qismdan iborat.
ex: The room had a dual function. It was a living room, but at night it was a bedroom.
exuz: Xonaning ikki vazifasi bor edi. U mehmonxona edi, lekin kechasi yotoqxonaga aylanardi.

def: Suv 32° da muzlab, 212° da qaynaydigan harorat shkalasi.
ex: When the temperature dropped to 32° Fahrenheit, it started snowing.
exuz: Harorat 32° Farengeytgacha tushganda qor yog'a boshladi.

def: Biror narsaga erishish yoki tugatish.
ex: The professor did not fulfill his promise not to miss a single class.
exuz: Professor birorta darsni o'tkazib yubormaslik haqidagi va'dasini bajarmadi.

def: Daraxtlarning kichik guruhi.
ex: All the trees in this grove are apple trees.
exuz: Bu bog'dagi hamma daraxt olma daraxti.

def: Qimmatbaho metall olinadigan xom tosh yoki material.
ex: The factory melted the ore and used it to make iron products.
exuz: Zavod rudani eritib, undan temir mahsulotlari yasadi.

def: Avstraliyaning juda kam odam yashaydigan yovvoyi hududi.
ex: Many Australian farmers use the outback to raise cattle.
exuz: Ko'p avstraliyalik fermer chorva boqish uchun ichki cho'l hududidan foydalanadi.

def: Biror narsadan qiymati, miqdori yoki ahamiyati ko'p bo'lish.
ex: Finding a warm place to sleep outweighed the need to find something to eat.
exuz: Uxlash uchun iliq joy topish ovqat izlash zaruratidan ustun keldi.

def: To'g'ri gap yoki haqiqiy voqea, lekin mantiqsiz ko'rinadi.
ex: The paradox of her work was that the less she worked, the more she got done.
exuz: Uning ishining paradoksi shu ediki, qancha kam ishlasa, shuncha ko'p ish bitirardi.

def: Suv havzasiga cho'zilgan inshoot.
ex: If you want to catch bigger fish, then go to the far end of the pier.
exuz: Kattaroq baliq tutmoqchi bo'lsangiz, iskalaning narigi uchiga boring.

def: Asosiy yo'ldan qisqaroq yo'l.
ex: We got to the house early because we took a shortcut through the forest.
exuz: Biz uyga erta yetib keldik, chunki o'rmon orqali qisqa yo'ldan bordik.

def: Ba'zi import yoki eksport uchun to'lanadigan soliq yoki to'lov.
ex: Our tariff on imported wool makes foreign wool more expensive.
exuz: Import junga solinadigan bojimiz xorijiy jun narxini oshiradi.

def: Haroratni o'lchaydigan asbob.
ex: The thermometer outside the window indicated that it was a hot day today.
exuz: Deraza tashqarisidagi termometr bugun issiq kun ekanini ko'rsatdi.

def: Biror narsani qiya holatga keltirish.
ex: She tilted her glass and almost spilled some of the cherry juice inside.
exuz: U stakanini qiyshaytirib, ichidagi gilos sharbatini deyarli to'kib yubordi.

def: Gap ikki asosiy g'oyasi o'rin almashsa.
ex: Students learn from their teachers, and vice versa.
exuz: O'quvchilar ustozlaridan o'rganadi, ustozlar ham o'quvchilaridan, aksincha.

def: Odam yoki narsa turgan joy.
ex: The police looked for the lost dog, but its whereabouts were still unknown.
exuz: Politsiya yo'qolgan itni qidirdi, lekin uning turgan joyi hali noma'lum edi.
